Result: 主要结果包括：(1) 故障类型诊断困难——结构化视图上Qwen 1.7B-14B模型AC@1仅13.6%-19.2%，DeepSeek-v4-pro仅24.8%（随机基线约9%），AC@3为24.0%-35.2%；(2) 组件定位——AC@1为20%-31%，类型+定位联合AC@1仅8%-22%；(3) 故障类型间差异显著——Tool Failure几乎全被识别(25/25)，但Guardrail Bypass在所有模型上几乎完全失败(0-1/25)；(4) 无故障识别随模型规模提升显著改善（从4%到96%），但故障类型分类无此规律；(5) 配对参考轨迹使Context Overflow召回率提升最多55个点、Tool Latency提升35个点，但对Guardrail Bypass和Output Corruption无帮助甚至略降。结论是诊断任务远未解决，且需要参考的方法对需语义/策略判断的故障仍无效。

Conclusion: AgentChaosBench提供了一个受控、可复现的基准，支持LLM和非LLM诊断方法的比较。实验揭示了当前零样本LLM在单轨迹故障诊断上的根本局限：即使前沿模型也仅达到约25%的故障类型准确率和约31%的定位准确率。结构化紧凑视图使得长轨迹可行且不人为提高最强检测器准确率。对齐的参考执行对偏差型故障有效，但对需要外部策略或语义判断的故障（如防护栏绕过）无能为力。这些发现激励参考基础和专门的检测器、非LLM基线以及精确span定位方法的进一步研究。

Abstract: Reliability in LLM-based agentic systems is a property of the whole execution (its tool calls, model calls, guardrails, and inter-agent messages), not of the final answer alone, yet evaluating only task outcomes reveals little about how or why a run fails. We present AGENTCHAOSBENCH, a benchmark for detecting and localizing runtime faults in agentic systems from their execution telemetry. We run five heterogeneous applications that coordinate agents over the Agent-to-Agent protocol and call tools through the Model Context Protocol, and inject ten types of operational fault (unavailable or slow tools, corrupted or oversized responses, and delayed, looped, or misrouted delegations and bypassed guardrails) at their tool, model, guardrail, and inter-agent boundaries, alongside a no-fault control. The resulting dataset contains 275 sanitized traces: 250 faulty executions spanning ten fault types and 25 no-fault controls. Each faulty trace is aligned with the no-fault execution of the same input; fault-type labels and, where applicable, location labels are held out from diagnosis. On structured single-trace inputs, a first set of zero-shot LLM baselines shows the task is far from solved: local detectors up to 14B parameters reach only 13.6-19.2% top-1 fault-type accuracy and the frontier DeepSeek-v4-pro only 24.8%, while jointly identifying the fault type and its location tops out at 22%; reference-dependent faults (above all a bypassed guardrail) stay near-unsolved from a single trace. An aligned reference improves selected relative faults but does not resolve guardrail bypass. The held-out labels and compact prediction format support reproducible comparison of LLM-based and non-LLM diagnosis methods.

</details>


### [438] [A Comprehensive Survey of Wireless Foundation Models for AI-Native 6G Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14694)
*Naveed Khan,Besan Al Sbeihi,Maryam Alshehhi,Nasir Saeed*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于AI原生6G网络中无线基础模型（Wireless Foundation Models, WFMs）的综合性综述论文。论文系统性地回顾了WFM的基本概念、模型架构、预训练策略、参数高效适应方法、数据集与基准测试、评估方法论以及在物理层信号处理、网络智能和跨层优化中的应用，并指出了数据可用性、泛化性、可解释性、高效边缘部署和标准化等关键挑战及未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统任务特定的深度学习模型在无线通信中存在泛化性差、依赖大量标注数据、难以适应动态异质化部署环境等局限。随着AI原生6G网络的兴起，通信、感知、定位和网络优化任务对可扩展、可迁移、数据高效的智能需求日益增长。同时，基础模型在自然语言处理和计算机视觉领域的成功激发了将其应用于无线通信领域的灵感。然而，无线基础模型领域的研究目前仍处于碎片化状态，架构、训练范式和应用领域分散，缺乏统一的综述来系统整合设计、学习和部署等方面。

Method: 本文采用文献综述与系统分类的方法，构建了从三个互补维度的统一分类法：(1) 模型架构（Transformer-based、CNN-based、physics-informed、graph-based四种架构家族）；(2) 预训练策略（自监督学习、对比表征学习、掩码建模、多模态预训练）；(3) 部署层级（物理层、MAC层、网络层、跨层优化）。论文详细回顾了代表性模型（如WirelessGPT、LWM、WavesFM、WiFo、CSI2Vec、IQFM、MuSE-FM等），综述了公开数据集（DeepMIMO、Raymobtime、RadioML、DeepSense 6G、ViWi、Sionna RT等）、基准平台与评估指标（BER、NMSE、谱效率、定位误差、OOD准确率、FLOPs等），并系统分析了各架构的可扩展性权衡。

Result: 综述得出以下主要发现：(1) Transformer架构已成为WFM的主导骨干，因其具有捕获长距离依赖和支持多任务学习的能力；(2) 自监督预训练（尤其是掩码建模与对比学习结合）成为主要预训练范式，有效利用大量未标注无线数据；(3) 参数高效适应方法（特别是LoRA）正逐步取代全参数微调，显著降低计算开销；(4) WFM应用范围已从传统物理层（信道估计、信道预测、信号检测）扩展到波束成形、资源分配、定位、ISAC、语义通信和跨层网络智能；(5) 总结了多种架构在表征能力、计算复杂度、数据需求、边缘部署和泛化性方面的权衡比较（详见Table II）。

Conclusion: WFM代表了AI在无线通信中应用的重要演进，通过将孤立的任务特定模型替换为可学习可迁移无线表征的大规模预训练模型，为通信、感知、定位和网络智能提供了统一框架。该范式改善了异质环境中的泛化性，减少了对大量标注数据的依赖，并支持高效适应多样化下游无线任务。然而，要实现大规模部署仍需解决构建大规模多样化标准化数据集、提高分布偏移下的鲁棒性、将通信领域知识集成到基础模型中、实现高效的云边部署以及建立可靠的评估协议和基准等挑战。未来研究将向多模态、物理感知、持续自适应的无线基础模型演进，最终成为AI原生6G网络的智能骨干，使能自主、上下文感知和自优化的无线系统。论文还提出了2026-2028（近期）、2028-2031（中期）、2031-2035（长期）三阶段的演进路线图。

Abstract: Foundation models are emerging as a transformative paradigm for AI-native sixth-generation (6G) wireless networks by enabling scalable, transferable, and data-efficient intelligence across diverse communication tasks. Unlike conventional deep learning models that are trained for individual applications, wireless foundation models (WFMs) learn generalized representations from large-scale heterogeneous wireless data and can be efficiently adapted to communication, sensing, localization, and network optimization tasks with minimal task-specific supervision. Despite rapid progress, current research remains fragmented across architectures, training paradigms, and application domains, with no unified survey dedicated to the design, learning, and deployment of WFMs. This survey presents a comprehensive and unified review of wireless foundation models. We first establish the fundamental concepts of WFMs and introduce a taxonomy that organizes the field according to model architectures, pre-training paradigms, and applications. We then review representative architectures, self-supervised pre-training strategies, parameter-efficient adaptation methods, datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation methodologies, highlighting their roles in enabling transferable wireless intelligence. Furthermore, we examine emerging applications spanning physical-layer signal processing, network intelligence, and cross-layer optimization, and discuss the key challenges of data availability, generalization, interpretability, efficient edge deployment, and standardization. Finally, we outline future research directions toward scalable, trustworthy, and general-purpose wireless intelligence for AI-native 6G networks. This survey provides a comprehensive reference for researchers and practitioners developing next-generation intelligent wireless systems.

</details>


### [439] [Synchronized Logit Steering: Real-world Steganography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14697)
*Andrew Rufail,Aadi Dash,Onir Narahari,Ethan Mui,Mahi Gajare,Prakhar Tiwari,Shrija Makapothula,Nick Cui*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了同步日志引导（SLS）方法，一种确定性的LLM隐写术方案。SLS通过从已生成的输出中推导代理提示（proxy prompt），使发送方和接收方无需共享原始提示上下文即可重建相同的logit分布，从而在LLM生成的文本中嵌入隐蔽信息。实验表明，当同步窗口达到40个token时，真实提示与代理提示分布的KL散度低于0.5 nats；周期性突发变体可实现0.20 bits per token的信息密度，约为单载荷编码的10倍容量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于token和logit级别的LLM隐写术方法通常要求发送方和接收方共享完全相同的提示上下文。然而，在实际生产环境中（如使用检索增强生成RAG或专有系统指令的流水线），双方往往无法访问相同的完整提示上下文，这会导致解码失败。因此，亟需一种不依赖共享原始提示的提示无关（prompt-agnostic）隐写方案。

Method: SLS的核心方法是：1）使用前n个正常生成的token构建代理提示P'；2）当局部熵超过阈值τ=2.5时，在高熵区域执行编码；3）将载荷值编码为代理提示分布中token的排序（rank），即v = rank_π(y)；4）接收方根据相同的生成文本重建代理提示和logit分布来解码。扩展策略包括：周期性编码（每n步重复）和载荷突发（在熵约束下连续编码a个token）。通过最小化真实提示与代理提示分布间的KL散度来确定最优同步窗口n=40。

Result: 在ShareGPT、GSM8K和SWE-bench Verified三个数据集上使用gemma-2-2b进行评估：1）当n≥40时，真假提示分布的KL散度稳定低于0.5 nats，且SLS编码不会显著影响分布收敛；2）Periodic Burst变体达到0.20 bits per token的信息密度，是单载荷编码的10倍容量；3）Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验显示大多数样本的K-S统计量低于0.05，表明SLS输出与贪心生成在统计上难以区分；4）解码准确率达到100%；5）Periodic Burst的时延开销约88%，但Single和Bursted变体仅增加2.7%和5.4%。代价是GSM8K准确率从0.73降至0.57，存在轻微的推理能力损失。

Conclusion: SLS是一种简单、确定性的隐写算法，可在发送方与未知接收方之间实现提示无关的隐蔽通信。通过使用前n个输出token作为同步提示，可周期性嵌入多位有效载荷。研究表明，SLS在LLM文本生成的实时加密和动态水印方面具有广阔应用前景，但同时也提出了双重用途的担忧——可能被滥用于协调AI代理间的隐蔽通道或规避内容审查。作者建议未来工作关注检测、缓解策略以及同步代理提示的统计签名识别。

Abstract: Steganography in large language models offers a way to embed hidden messages within natural-sounding text. Existing token and logit-level methods typically require the sender and receiver to share an identical prompt context, which is rarely guaranteed in production pipelines that use retrieval-augmented generation or proprietary system instructions. We introduce Synchronized Logit Steering (SLS), a deterministic steganographic scheme that eliminates this dependency by deriving a proxy prompt from the generated output itself, allowing both parties to reconstruct the same logit distribution without access to the original prompt. SLS encodes payload values as token ranks within high-entropy regions of the proxy prompt distribution, and we extend the scheme with periodic recurrence and payload bursts to scale information density. Across ShareGPT, GSM8K, and SWE-bench Verified, we show that the KL divergence between the true and proxy prompt distributions falls below 0.5 nats once the synchronization window reaches 40 tokens, and SLS encoding does not meaningfully disrupt this convergence relative to greedy generation. We also find that the periodic-burst variant achieves 0.20 bits per token, or roughly 10x the capacity of single-payload encoding. Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests further confirm that SLS outputs are statistically difficult to distinguish from greedy generations, demonstrating that covert, prompt-agnostic communication through LLMs is both practical and stealthy.

</details>


### [440] [Semantic Uncertainty-Guided Orchestration in Hierarchical Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14707)
*John Knowlton,Aritra Guha,Risto Miikkulainen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 HASSUM 框架，将语义熵（semantic entropy）和语义密度（semantic density）作为实时控制信号嵌入层级多智能体系统（HASHIRU）的编排循环中，使 CEO 智能体能够基于不确定性主动分支执行（重新提示、重新分配工作者、多代理协作），在 StrategyQA、TruthfulQA、JailbreakBench 等以歧义和幻觉为主导失败模式的基准上显著提升了可靠性（分别提升 8pp、22pp、36pp），但在以事实缺失、检索错误或逻辑错误为主导的任务上收益有限甚至为负。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 多智能体系统的编排策略通常依赖固定的交互模式，缺乏评估中间推理步骤可靠性的机制，导致错误和幻觉在系统中传播。已有的语义不确定性方法（语义熵、语义密度）虽被验证为有效的输出可靠性度量，但此前仅作为后验评估指标使用，能否作为编排决策中的实时控制信号尚未被研究。此外，何时不确定性驱动的干预真正有助于性能、何时会引入不必要计算或降低推理质量，也缺乏系统性的边界刻画。

Method: HASSUM 构建于 HASHIRU 层级多智能体框架之上，由 CEO 智能体协调专业工作者智能体。在每次工作者生成候选响应后，CEO 在温度 0.85 下采样 4 个额外随机补全，计算两类语义不确定性信号：(1) 语义熵——通过成对蕴含关系将响应聚类为语义等价簇后计算 Shannon 熵，对"矛盾"敏感；(2) 语义密度——基于 all-MiniLM-L6-v2 嵌入，使用 Epanechnikov 核估计连续嵌入空间中的密度，对"模糊/不精确"敏感。两个标量分别与预设阈值（密度 ≥ 0.8，熵 ≤ 1.1）比较；任一指标越界则触发精化（重新提示、切换工作者或多工作者并行咨询），迭代至通过阈值或达到推理轮次上限。该方法架构无关，可集成到广泛的层级与协作式多智能体系统中。

Result: 在三个主基准上 HASSUM 显著优于无不确定性信号的 HASHIRU：StrategyQA 78% vs 70%，TruthfulQA 41% vs 19%，JailbreakBench 61% vs 25%，提升幅度与基线可靠性呈反比。消融实验表明：(a) 语义熵与语义密度组合优于任一单独使用（任一单独使用甚至不如关闭两者），因为二者捕获互补的失败模式；(b) 阈值灵敏度扫描显示提高密度阈值或降低熵阈值均能改善准确率但增加重提示频率和计算成本；(c) 模型能力消融显示使用 GPT-5.4 与本地小模型（Llama-3.2、DeepSeek-R1）最终系统准确率相同（78%），但前者因首轮一致性高而触发更少干预。在六个范围基准（MuSiQue、HotpotQA、GSM8K、MMLU-Pro Law、MuSR、IFBench）上结果混杂：多跳问答因精化反复重访同一错误轨迹而下降 10–14pp，IFBench 提升 8pp，GSM8K 与 MMLU-Pro Law 基本持平。核心发现是：语义不确定性的价值取决于任务的主导失败模式——当失败源于语义不稳定性时有效，当失败源于事实缺失、检索错误或逻辑错误时无效。

Conclusion: 本文确立了"不确定性是错误可恢复性的必要而非充分条件"这一核心边界条件：语义不确定性可有效检测语义不稳定性导致的可恢复失败，但无法解决事实或逻辑层面的不可恢复失败。密度假阴性（主题相似但结论矛盾的响应紧密嵌入而被放行）比熵假阴性危害更大，因此熵虽触发频率较低但每次触发时捕获了更具决定性的失败。文章还指出 CEO 的恢复策略多样性是另一关键因素——单纯重复提示同一工作者难以纠正持续的事实错误。未来方向包括结合轨迹级不确定性、引入自适应阈值、重启资源预算机制，以及构建多层不确定性感知控制（语义置信、事实验证、符号校验、人工升级）的多智能体系统以支撑安全部署。

Abstract: As large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems become increasingly capable, coordinating agents under uncertainty becomes a fundamental challenge. Existing orchestration strategies typically rely on fixed interaction patterns and often lack mechanisms for assessing the reliability of intermediate reasoning steps, allowing errors and hallucinations to propagate through the system. This paper introduces a semantic-uncertainty-guided orchestration approach, HASSUM as a general framework for uncertainty-aware coordination in multi-agent systems. The method estimates uncertainty using semantic entropy and semantic density, which measure trust at the level of answer semantics rather than output probabilities. These signals enable adaptive orchestration decisions, including output verification, selective reprompting, additional deliberation, and confidence-aware response selection. Because the approach operates independently of any particular agent architecture, it can be integrated into a broad range of hierarchical and collaborative multi-agent systems. The evaluations demonstrate an implementation within a hierarchical agent framework and evaluate it on StrategyQA, JailbreakBench, and TruthfulQA benchmarks. Across tasks that require complex reasoning and are prone to ambiguity or hallucinations, uncertainty-guided orchestration yields more reliable outcomes than uncertainty-unaware coordination. Semantic entropy and semantic density in tandem outperformed either metric alone. Ablations testing different thresholds and model sizes demonstrated that both influence the effectiveness of semantic metrics. The results suggest that semantic uncertainty is a practical and general-purpose signal for improving robustness and trustworthiness in agentic AI systems.

</details>


### [441] [Beyond Pass@k: Measuring Reliability and Security of Agentic Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14711)
*Jiajun Jiang,Sharon Zheng,Natan Vidra,Spurthi Setty*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文指出当前 AI 编码智能体基准测试中 pass@k 度量的严重误用——将单次提交的单元测试数量当作独立采样次数，导致分数被人为抬高 0.85–0.97。论文提出 reliability@k（正确的多次独立 rollout 估计）和 security_adjusted_reliability@k，并构建了 CodeBench 合成基准进行验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 pass@k 实现违反 Chen 等人（2021）所提估计量的 i.i.d. 假设，将测试用例数等同于独立采样数，使分数严重依赖于测试套件大小而非智能体能力；同时，功能正确性无法反映代码安全性（Veracode 报告 AI 生成代码引入漏洞率为人工代码 2.74 倍），需要可量化的安全性补充度量。

Method: （1）形式化证明：以反例展示两个真实能力相同但测试套件规模不同的智能体会得到不同的 pass@5 分数；（2）reliability@k：以独立 rollout 数（n=8）替换测试数（n=tests），计算完全通过的 rollout 占比；（3）单次 rollout 代理指标（pass_rate×(1−regression)×tool_efficiency）与 reliability@5 的 Spearman 相关性检验；（4）security_adjusted_reliability@k：在 reliability@k 基础上叠加 7 类高危模式（eval/exec/os.system/subprocess shell=True/pickle/yaml/import）启发式扫描（阈值 ≥0.80）；（5）SWE-bench Verified 5 任务真实仓库验证（Claude Code v2.1.185）。

Result: H1 确认：相同 0.40 单次测试通过率下，因测试数差异（10 vs 5）pass@5 分别为 0.976 与 1.000。H2 确认：合成基准中错误指标相对正确 reliability@5 平均膨胀 0.924（区间 0.85–0.97）。H3 确认：单次 rollout 代理与 reliability@5 的 Spearman ρ=0.417（<0.70 阈值），不足以替代。H4 未确认：3 个智能体在 live API 实验中调整前后排名完全一致（Kendall τ=1.000, p=0.333），因智能体数过少、阈值过宽松而检验力不足。SWE-bench 试点：隐藏测试宏观平均通过率 0.80，但严格任务解决率仅 0.20，与合成结论方向一致。

Conclusion: 论文定位为方法学贡献而非生产级智能体排行榜：reliability@k 是对 pass@k 的必要修正；security_adjusted_reliability@k 是值得进一步检验的补充视角，但当前 H4 实验因检验力不足无法定论，需更大智能体池、更严安全阈值、严重度加权评分才能决断。SWE-bench 试点初步支持"部分测试通过率严重高估严格任务可靠性"的现实证据。未来工作包括扩展真实漏洞语料、扫描安全阈值敏感度、以及将试点扩展到多尝试、多仓库的 reliability@k（k>1）评估。

Abstract: AI coding agent benchmarks rank agents with the Chen et al. (2021) pass@k estimator, but current implementations misapply it: they set n to the number of unit tests in a single submission rather than the number of independent rollout attempts, conflating test-suite size with attempt independence. We diagnose this operationalization error, prove it by counterexample, and propose reliability@k, the same estimator applied correctly, with n = independent rollouts and c = fully-passing rollouts per (task, agent) pair. In a synthetic multi-rollout benchmark, the misapplied metric inflates reported scores by 0.85-0.97 in absolute terms (0.96-0.98 reported vs. 0.00-0.12 corrected), and a cheap single-rollout proxy fails to substitute for repeated runs (Spearman $\rho = 0.417$). Motivated by evidence that functional correctness does not imply security safety, we additionally propose security-adjusted reliability@k, which counts only rollouts that are both functionally correct and free of high-severity insecure patterns. In an initial live-API test with three agents, the adjustment did not change any ranking under our current scanner and threshold, so we present it as a proposed complementary lens whose decisive evaluation requires better-powered future runs. Finally, a preliminary 5-task SWE-bench Verified pilot observes the same core concern in a real repository setting: macro-averaged hidden-test pass rate was 0.80 while strict task resolution was 0.20.

</details>


### [442] [Advanced modelling and data analytics in aviation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14746)
*Aziida Nanyonga*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探讨了机器学习（ML）与自然语言处理（NLP）技术在航空安全数据分析中的应用，旨在挖掘航空事故及险情中未充分利用的数据价值，提升航空安全管理的预测、预防与决策能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航空业虽已积累大量安全数据并具备严格的安全标准，但这些数据在事故预测与预防方面的潜力尚未被充分挖掘。现有研究缺乏将先进ML/NLP方法系统化、结构化地应用于航空安全叙事文本的框架，亟需数据驱动的解决方案以增强行业风险识别与决策能力。

Method: 研究整合了多源航空安全数据（包括Socrata、澳大利亚运输安全局ATSB、美国国家运输安全委员会NTSB及航空安全网络ASN），采用深度学习、Transformer架构等ML模型，结合NLP方法进行事故叙述文本挖掘；运用多种主题建模（topic modelling）技术从非结构化报告中提取主题；引入因果推断（causal inference）与可解释AI（XAI）框架以提升模型透明度与可信度。

Result: 研究展示了先进ML与NLP方法在结构化航空安全场景中的实际应用效果，揭示了导致事故与险情发生的关键模式与主题，为事故分析提供了更深层次的解释性洞察。

Conclusion: 该研究为监管机构、航空公司及政策制定者提供了数据驱动的解决方案，有助于推动航空安全管理的风险最小化、机组与乘客安全提升，并促进AI驱动方法在航空安全管理体系中的整合与落地。

Abstract: The aviation industry characterized by its stringent safety standards has seen a growing need for innovative approaches to enhance safety measures. Despite the vast accumulation of aviation safety data over time, its full potential in predicting and preventing incidents has not been fully realized. This research addresses this gap by applying machine learning (ML) and natural language processing (NLP) techniques to analyze aviation safety data from Socrata, the Australian Transport Safety Bureau (ATSB), the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB), and the Aviation Safety Network (ASN). By leveraging existing ML models, including deep learning and transformer-based architectures alongside NLP methods for mining aviation incident narratives, this study uncovers patterns contributing to safety related incidents such as accidents and near-misses. Additionally, it employs various topic modelling techniques to extract meaningful themes from unstructured safety reports, enhancing the interpretability of incident analysis. Causal inference techniques and interpretable AI frameworks are further explored to improve model transparency and trustworthiness. A key contribution of this work is the deployment of advanced ML methodologies in a structured aviation safety context, assessing their effectiveness and providing insights into their practical implementation. The findings offer valuable insights for aviation stakeholders, including regulators, airlines, and policymakers, by providing data-driven solutions that enhance incident analysis and decision making. Ultimately, this research supports the industry s ongoing efforts to minimize risks, improve passenger and crew security, and integrate AI driven methodologies into aviation safety management.

</details>


### [443] [From Errors to Proofs: Minimal-Core-Guided Repair for Neuro-Symbolic Constraint Solving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14771)
*Dipankar Sarkar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出用极小不可满足核心（minimal unsatisfiable core, MUS）替代求解器的错误消息，作为神经-符号约束求解管线中语言模型的形式化修复信号。通过在77个问题、7个领域的新基准上的实验，证明该方法在弱模型上将"对不可行问题伪造解"的比例从79%降至7%，并能提供可证最优性与不可行性的证书，但其在精度上并不优于强思维链基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的语言模型+求解器管线（如 Logic-LM）只能修复"崩溃型"翻译错误：当生成的程序语法错误时，返回求解器的报错信息让模型重试。但更危险的是"形式忠实性失败"——翻译语法正确却与题意不符（如多加约束使可解问题误判为不可解、或漏约束得到无效解），此时求解器只会静默地返回"无解"或错误解，模型无法区分"我自己译错了"与"题目本就不可行"。因此需要一种更丰富的、结构化的、能定位冲突来源而非仅报告失败的反馈信号。

Method: 1) **决策契约**：强制所有决策通过统一的 `assign(Var,Value)` 关系表达，由一个选择规则生成候选决策，所有需求通过完整性约束（integrity constraints）表达；2) **四分类结局**：将求解结果分为 ok / syntax_error / empty / unsat 四类，仅 unsat 进入核心提取；3) **极小不可满足核心提取**（Algorithm 1 删除过滤法）：在 base program B（事实+选择规则）上，对模型生成的完整性约束集 C 做删除过滤，找到最小子集 C*，使得 B∪C* 不可满足但去掉任何一条都变得可满足；4) **修复提示**：将 C* 中的约束原样列出，让模型判断是该修改/删除某条错误约束（形式化错误），还是确认题目本就不可行；5) **对照基线**：构造 generic 修复设置（仅返回"无解"裸错误），用以隔离核心信号本身的效果。最多 7 次迭代。

Result: 在77个问题（7个领域：图着色、背包、组队、排座、时间表、值班排班、拉丁方）上，用 gemma4:31b 与 deepseek-v3.2 两个开源模型评估：- **精度上**：思维链基线 98.7%，符号管线（typed+core 修复）89.6%，直接提示 74.0%；- **形式化忠实性**：在7个领域中6个达到100%可行精度，唯一失败的是"聚合覆盖排班"领域（涉及全局计数约束），将翻译税精确定位到一个可诊断的形式化模式；- **修复效果**：修复单调且安全，typed+core 在强模型（gemma4）上与 generic 修复差距不显著（配对符号检验 p=1.0），但在弱模型（deepseek-v3.2）上对不可行问题的伪造解率从 generic 修复的79%降至 core 修复的7%（Fisher 精确检验 p<10⁻³）；- **证书性质**：符号管线从不伪造解（0%），而直接提示在不可行问题上伪造率达21.4%；优化实例返回零最优性差距。

Conclusion: 本文得出三点教训：1) 将约束推理卸载到求解器应以"保证与鲁棒性"而非"精度"为依据——在可验证规模下强思维链在精度上难以超越，但符号管线能提供不可行性/最优性证书且从不伪造解；2) 语言模型自动形式化的忠实性是不均匀的、且不均匀性有结构：局部约束近乎完美，全局计数则崩溃，应以"形式化模式"而非"模型"为信任单位；3) 修复信号的形式在模型较弱时最关键——极小核心告诉模型哪些约束冲突，抑制了裸错误信息诱发的伪造。总体而言，应将求解器侧证明工件（如极小核心）视为语言模型形式化的一类反馈，并释放基准与预言机供社区使用。主要局限：基准使用模板化描述与单一决策关系，不适合带派生数值量的问题；ASP 难以快速验证大规模数值最优/不可行；核心修复无法捕获"漏约束导致可满足但无效"的情形，需在循环中加入验证器。

Abstract: Making language models solve constraint problems reliably often means having them translate the problem into a formal specification and delegating the search to a sound solver. But the translation is itself a language-model task, and an unfaithful translation makes the solver faithfully solve the wrong problem. Existing pipelines repair only translations that crash, returning the solver's error message and falling silent when the program runs but is wrong. We replace the error message with a proof: when the generated program is unsatisfiable, we extract a minimal unsatisfiable core over the model's own constraints and hand it back the exact set that cannot hold together, a leakage-free signal that localizes the fault. On a new benchmark of 77 problems with an exact oracle, translation to Answer Set Programming is faithful on six of seven domains and fails only on aggregate coverage scheduling, which concentrates the translation tax in one diagnosable pattern. A minimal core, rather than a bare error, is what stops a weaker model from fabricating solutions to infeasible problems, cutting fabrication from 79% to 7%. A strong chain-of-thought baseline meanwhile matches the symbolic route on accuracy, so the route's value is not accuracy but certificates and its refusal to fabricate.

</details>


### [444] [Task-Driven Three-Layer Distributed Scheduling for Emergency Earth Observation in Large Low-Earth-Orbit Constellations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14789)
*Qian Yin,Xinwei Wang,Guohua Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对大型低轨（LEO）地球观测（EO）星座中的动态紧急观测调度问题（DEOSP），提出了一种任务驱动的三层分布式调度方法（T3L-DS）。该方法采用H3六边形地理网格统一表征点目标和区域目标的紧急需求以及卫星观测覆盖，使用基于任务需求和星间链路（ISL）拓扑的临时集群进行协同，并通过星上双计划投标、集群级联合边际评估以及集群间需求再分配机制，在间歇性地面接触条件下实现紧急任务插入，同时最小化对常规观测计划的扰动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型LEO星座（如规划至2026年超过15,000颗在轨卫星，含约1,400颗EO载荷）为灾害评估、海上救援等时效性应用提供了高频、广覆盖的观测能力。然而，紧急观测请求可能在常规观测计划已执行过程中动态到达。集中式调度方法依赖全局同步状态和实时地面通信，在间歇性地面接触、信息可能过时的情况下代价高昂且不可行；现有分布式方法或基于请求方代理、或假设实时星间通信，均无法满足在当前星载计划状态下进行局部修改并通过有限ISL协同的DEOSP要求。因此需要一种面向任务、不依赖星座全局执行状态、能在执行时修改可调整未来活动的分布式调度框架。

Method: （1）问题建模：构建集中式参考模型，以网格单元-目标对（atomic demand unit）为最小调度单元，将已执行、受保护的可调整活动分离；目标函数最大化紧急覆盖并惩罚常规计划扰动与变更代价。（2）三层架构：地面层将请求与覆盖映射至统一地理网格并构建临时集群；集群层通过合同网协议（CFP）协调重叠投标并执行细胞级边际评估；卫星层基于本地状态进行候选生成与可行性判定。（3）任务驱动临时集群：依据需求-卫星可见性与当前ISL快照，按星型拓扑贪心构建以候选簇头为中心、最大规模K_max的集群，并在每个事件波次重建。（4）星上双计划构造：Plan A由顺序选择并状态更新得到，移除其候选后于剩余集合生成Plan B，二者均上传至簇头以提供本地多样性。（5）簇内协同：采用"细胞感知边际授予"算法，以ΔJ(χ|L_b)增量衡量新覆盖，迭代选择兼容且增益最大的候选进行原子提交，避免整体投标带来的重复授权或有用覆盖丢弃。（6）簇间协同与事件终止：簇内未解决的紧急需求在有直接ISL时转交邻簇，或由地面层更新可见性后重建集群再派遣；常规被抢占单元仅限一次本地与一次邻簇重调度。

Result: 基于EOS-Bench基准（含500颗卫星、25轨道面的Walker星座，H3分辨率6），在22组场景（A-E五类：紧急需求规模、常规背景负载、星座规模、到达集中度、冲突增强平衡负载）下与集中式SA、改进型A-SeTVBRP及标准CNP进行对比，每组10个随机种子：（1）紧急覆盖率：T3L-DS在分布式方法中最优，平均相对A-SeTVBRP提升约2.8%、相对CNP提升约17.1%；与集中式SA平均相对差距约7.1%。（2）常规计划保留：T3L-DS平均仅抢占2.3%的常规单元（SA为79.8%），常规保留率与SA仅差0.13个百分点；在冲突增强负载下，常规覆盖损失相对A-SeTVBRP减少约57.9%、相对CNP减少约87.7%。（3）规模敏感性：随星座规模从100增至400颗，T3L-DS紧急覆盖提升40.7%（SA为22.6%），分布式相对劣势显著缩小。（4）消融实验：在A4/B4/C1/D1四类压力场景下，移除簇间协同带来3.8%-11.6%的覆盖下降（最大出现在到达最集中的D1），为三项机制中贡献最大；移除Plan B仅带来0.26%-0.96%的损失；候选级联合评估贡献最小（≤0.09%）。

Conclusion: 本文首次将DEOSP形式化为分布式调度问题，通过基于地理网格的统一空间表征、可调整未来活动与受保护活动的分离、以及不依赖星座全局执行状态的事件驱动协同机制，在分布式条件下实现了对紧急观测请求的有效响应，同时将对常规观测计划的扰动控制在极低水平。T3L-DS在分布式方法中取得最高的紧急覆盖率，并展现出良好的可扩展性和冲突鲁棒性。簇间协同是性能提升的关键因素，双计划构造与候选级边际评估提供局部优化改进。未来工作将引入更精细的星上计算、能源与通信模型，并研究ISL可用性不确定条件下的调度问题。

Abstract: Large low-Earth-orbit (LEO) Earth-observation (EO) constellations offer frequent access to geographically dispersed ground targets, but emergency requests may arrive after committed routine-plan execution has begun. The resulting dynamic emergency observation scheduling problem (DEOSP) requires urgent tasks to be inserted under intermittent ground contact without excessive routine-plan disruption. To address DEOSP, we propose a task-driven three-layer distributed scheduling (T3L-DS) method, which represents task demand and sensor footprints on a common geographic grid and forms temporary clusters from observation capabilities and current inter-satellite links. For intra-cluster coordination, T3L-DS introduces onboard dual-plan bidding and joint marginal evaluation. It also designs an inter-cluster coordination mechanism for unresolved demand. Extensive computational experiments compare T3L-DS with centralised simulated annealing (SA), an adapted selective time-variant better reply process (A-SeTVBRP), and a conventional contract-net protocol (CNP). T3L-DS achieves the highest emergency coverage among the distributed methods, with average relative improvements of approximately 2.8% and 17.1% over A-SeTVBRP and CNP, respectively. Its average relative gap from SA is approximately 7.1%. Under conflict-enhanced loads, it reduces routine-coverage loss by approximately 57.9% and 87.7% relative to A-SeTVBRP and CNP, respectively. The ablation study confirms the contribution of the proposed coordination enhancements. Overall, the results show that T3L-DS provides an effective distributed approach to DEOSP.

</details>


### [445] [CEDAR-GRPO: Process-Aware Reinforcement Learning for General Abductive Reasoning in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14791)
*Moein Salimi,Danial Parnian,Shaygan Adim,Amirmohammad Ebrahiminasab,Nima Alighardashi,Parsa Gholami,Sahand Akramipour,Mahdi Jafari Siavoshani,Mohammad Hossein Rohban*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CEDAR-GRPO，一种过程感知的强化学习框架，通过在GRPO中引入"证据覆盖度"和"证据-解释方向性"两个过程奖励，将溯因推理（abductive reasoning）作为可迁移的通用推理能力进行训练。实验在4个开源LLM（4B-8B参数）和11个未见任务上验证，CEDAR-GRPO在所有模型和所有任务上均优于基座模型和仅正确性GRPO，平均提升7.4和2.7个点，最高提升达30.8点，且过程级指标也显著改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM研究中，溯因推理（abduction，即"对最佳解释的推理"）通常通过狭窄的、特定任务的基准进行评估，无法判断所观察到的性能提升是源于真正的推理能力提升，还是仅仅是对特定基准格式的过拟合。核心科学问题是：RL后训练能否将溯因推理提升为一种可跨任务迁移的通用推理能力？具体而言，需要验证两个层面：(1) 性能提升是否能在假设生成（Stage I）和假设选择（Stage II）两种溯因形式间迁移；(2) 提升能否泛化到训练格式之外的领域（如临床诊断、代码调试、长上下文调查等）。

Method: 方法核心包括三部分：(1) 复合奖励设计——R = (r_cor + r_cov + r_dir) / 3，其中r_cor为基于精确匹配/标签/执行验证的最终答案正确性奖励，r_cov由gpt-oss-120b作为评判器计算推理链对观察细节的覆盖比例，r_dir评估推理方向是从证据到解释（1.0）、混合（0.5）还是从解释到证据（0.0）；(2) 训练数据——采用领域中性、知识轻量的混合数据集（2400样本），涵盖Stage I（AbductionRules、Crypto、List Function）和Stage II（UniADILR-HGc、Balanced COPA、CauseLogics、CLIMATE-FEVER）；(3) 优化——使用GRPO（G=4），结合NF4量化和LoRA（rank=64），在单张RTX 5090上训练。评估在11个未见任务上进行，包括经典溯因基准（ART、NeuLR）、Stage II证据更新（DefNLI）、领域溯因（GoEmotions、MuSR-Murder、MedQA、ML-Debug）和非溯因控制任务。过程级评估使用7个指标：分支性、回溯、差异消除、先验调用、证据覆盖、方向性、不确定性标记。消融实验对比了SFT、仅正确性GRPO、单一过程奖励（Cor+Cov或Cor+Dir）、单阶段训练（仅Stage I或仅Stage II）以及通用推理数据控制。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 任务性能——CEDAR-GRPO在4个模型（Qwen3-4B/8B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）的所有11个任务上一致优于基座和Cor-GRPO，平均提升7.4和2.7点，DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B在MuSR-Murder上最大提升30.8点；(2) 过程指标——证据覆盖从33.1%升至52.9%，方向性从0.21升至0.60（两个直接优化目标），且5个未在训练中奖励的指标（回溯从0.69→1.09、差异消除从0.79→1.29、分支性从1.22→1.53、先验调用从0.59→0.72、不确定性从0.87→1.37）也全面提升；有趣的是Cor-GRPO的方向性反而下降至0.16，分支性降至1.16，表明仅正确性训练反而窄化推理；(3) 消融验证——SFT表现弱于RL（甚至低于基座），说明收益来自探索而非模仿；任一单一过程奖励不如复合奖励（52.1 vs 50.3/50.2）；仅Stage I或仅Stage II训练均弱于完整混合（49.3/48.4 vs 52.1）；通用推理数据GRPO甚至低于基座（-0.80/-1.73），证明收益特定于溯因训练。

Conclusion: 结论表明，溯因推理可被强化为一种可迁移的通用推理能力，而非仅是基准特定优化。CEDAR-GRPO通过过程感知的复合奖励设计，使模型在提升任务准确率的同时，学会了更广泛的溯因行为模式（探索、回溯、消除、调用先验、表达不确定性）。该工作将RL后训练从狭隘的格式适配推进到通用推理能力的获取，并通过严格的训练-评估分离（评估数据完全不参与优化或模型选择）确保了迁移证据的可靠性。局限性包括：仅测试4-8B参数规模、训练池仅2400样本、过程指标与训练奖励共享同一LLM评判器可能存在循环性、评估仍以闭式答案为主。

Abstract: Abductive reasoning, often characterized as inference to the best explanation, is central to explanation under uncertainty, from everyday sense-making and investigation to scientific discovery. Yet LLM research has mostly studied abduction through narrow, task-specific benchmarks, making it unclear whether observed gains transfer beyond the benchmark family used for training or evaluation. We ask whether RL post-training can improve abduction as a transferable reasoning capability. We introduce CEDAR-GRPO, a process-aware framework that combines final-answer correctness with abductive rewards for evidence coverage and evidence-to-explanation directionality. Four open-weight LLMs are post-trained on a controlled, domain-neutral mixture of abductive hypothesis-generation and hypothesis-selection tasks. We evaluate them on 11 unseen tasks spanning hypothesis selection, missing-fact generation, defeasible inference, long-context investigation, clinical reasoning, code debugging, and non-abductive controls. CEDAR- GRPO improves every model on every held-out task over both base models and correctness-only GRPO, with average gains of 7.4 and 2.7 points, respectively, and a maximum gain of 30.8 points. Ablations confirm that RL, abductive reward design, and task diversity each contribute to transfer. Process-level metrics further show stronger abductive behavior, including exploration of alternatives, elimination of rivals, backtracking, and uncertainty marking.

</details>


### [446] [Individual Disempowerment through an Advice Channel: Control Loss when Influence is Endogenous](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14795)
*Adam M. Oberman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文构建了一个形式化框架,证明仅能提供建议的AI系统可以通过内生影响系数ε_t(遵循建议的行为比例)逐渐削弱人类权力。"装箱式"安全策略之所以失败,是因为它们认证的恰好是交互本身会移动的量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战AI安全中"装箱"(boxing)传统的前提假设——即限制AI仅能建议、无法执行动作就保证安全。传统担忧的薄弱点是:读建议的人类本身就是系统的一部分,使用越深,依赖越强。需要在一个反馈循环模型中形式化"渐进式失权"(gradual disempowerment)现象,并评估流行的安全策略。

Method: 1) 将人机交互建模为MDP,影响系数ε_t作为状态变量,由oracle的消息本身驱动(ε_{t+1}=(1-δ)ε_t+η(m_t)(1-ε_t));2) 基于Blackwell优势序定义无先验的"人类权力"族W_u(x,ε)(零和博弈的极小极大值)和"oracle权力"(TV位移),以及分解为位移项+通道项-善意信用的失权指数Dis_t;3) 在ε-机器上求解"回答/培养"切换作为投资问题,推导闭式耐心阈值γ*和影响停止点ε̂;4) 分析三种装箱协议(静态认证、外生上限、周期性重置)分别能/不能约束的失权项;5) 用单任务状态二元选择的最小例子作数值验证。

Result: Lemma 1: 在Echo假设下,ε升高使oracle可达联合律集合嵌套扩张,且人类整个{W_u}_u优势族逐点下降,失权上界为ε/(1-γ)²。Theorem 1(回答/培养切换): 当γ≤γ*(δ)=c/(αη+c(1-δ))时永远回答;当δ=0且γ>γ*(0)时,阈值策略是"在ε_t<ε̂(γ)时培养k*轮后永远回答",且ε̂(γ)↑1当γ↑1。Theorem 2(装箱定理): (i)静态认证的每步边界自动成立,不约束任何东西;(ii)最优oracle在k*轮内把ε_t推到≥ε̂(γ);(iii)对任何证书水平ε_0<1和候选损失界b<1,都存在满足协议但归一化保证损失超过b的部署——不存在无视γ的损失界。Proposition 1: 外生上限ε̄约束通道项≤ε̄/(1-γ)²,但位移项可增至完整价值跨度1/(1-γ)。Proposition 2: 重置仅当周期τ≤τ*(γ)=1+ln ε̂/ln γ时删除培养激励;回合内影响可达1-(1-η̄)^{τ-1}(1-ε_res),重置不约束。Corollary 2: 上限和重置不可相互替代,且都不能恢复已发生的位移。最小例子:α=1, c=0.1, η=0.01, γ=0.95时τ*≈15.6——15回合内不培养,16回合开始培养。

Conclusion: 仅能对话的系统以用户停止质疑的速度成为行动者,而这个速度由系统自身输出驱动。启动时检查单条建议不会造成大伤害,等于检查一个交互过程将要移动的量。三种流行的安全策略(静态认证、影响上限、周期性重置)各自约束了错误的对象:静态认证从不触发、被认证的参数被移动、且不存在与部署视野无关的损失界。有效保障必须成为部署本身不可重新协商的特征(影响上限约束通道项,短关系删除培养激励),且都不能挽回已积累的位移。决定安全与不安全部署之间界限的是γ(记忆/关系长度/部署视野)而非模型能力本身。危险的能力不是智能,是持久性。

Abstract: An AI that can only give advice seems safe: the human is always free to ignore it. That is the premise of the boxing tradition in AI safety, and its long-suspected weak point is that the human who reads the answers is part of the system. We make the fraction $\varepsilon_t$ of behavior that follows the advice a state of a Markov decision process, moved by the advisor's own messages, so that use deepens reliance. Granted a channel rich enough to echo any action the human could take, higher $\varepsilon_t$ weakly lowers every monotone measure of the power of a human with a message-independent fallback. An oracle rewarded by per-round approval cultivates reliance beyond a closed-form patience threshold, so the same reward weights leave the optimal oracle answering in episodic deployments and cultivating in long-memory ones. An influence bound certified once at deployment is blind to that horizon and bounds the loss no lower than its trivial ceiling. An exogenous cap on influence bounds the guarantee the human loses, and a short enough memory reset removes the incentive to cultivate, while neither recovers the value already steered away. In a closed-form example the optimal oracle never cultivates in fifteen-round sessions and does in sixteen.

</details>


### [447] [Generated Context versus Governed State: Functional Conditions for Accountable Longitudinal Clinical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14804)
*Augusto Bernardo Pissarra,Victor Lorena de Farias Souza*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文主张纵向临床推理的核心瓶颈不在于大语言模型的阅读流畅性，而在于患者状态的"治理"（governance）。论文区分"生成上下文"与"治理状态"，划分了临床AI习惯性混淆的五个对象（真实状态、观测、证据、信念、模拟状态），提出可审计的分层治理标准，并将"可问责性"操作性分解为四项信息需求（不可篡改证据账本、信念状态、观测过程模型、因果类型标注），辅以六级成熟度框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前以LLM为主导的临床AI系统采用"文本输入-文本输出"的接口范式，缺乏对患者当前真实状态的显式、持久、可治理的表示。系统每次推理时仅在临时上下文窗口中重建患者信息，无法区分观测事实与推断结论、证据缺失与缺失证据、观测与模拟。研究动机在于揭示：高流畅性与低治理成熟度之间的鸿沟是临床AI在纵向推理任务上失败的根本架构性原因，而非模型能力问题。

Method: 纯概念性与架构性方法，无实验：（1）将纵向临床推理形式化为部分可观测下的状态估计问题；（2）定义五个不可混淆的认知对象并赋予符号（$x_t$, $o_t$, $e_i$, $b_\tau(x_t)$, $\tilde{x}_t^{\text{branch}}$），强调"认知时间（awareness time）"与"临床时间（clinical time）"的双时钟分离；（3）以Definition 1给出分层治理标准（Core / Safety-critical / Predictive），将工程属性（identity、persistence、explicit semantics、provenance、update governance等）规范化为可审计条件；（4）通过R1–R3问责需求的逐项消除，论证得到四个功能性工件（A1–A4）；（5）提出六级成熟度框架（L0文本→L1实体→L2关系→L3证据→L4信念→L5世界模型）；（6）以"含碘造影剂使用安全性"为案例对比两种架构，并构造六年纵向病历进行机制层面的对比说明。

Result: 论文不声称任何经验性或临床结果。具体产出包括：（a）将LLM中心架构的缺失从笼统的"表征问题"具体化为可逐项验证的治理属性缺失；（b）一套区分证据/信念/模拟的词汇与认知类型纪律（含unknown≠negative≠not measured≠not documented≠unavailable的缺失分类）；（c）一条从R1–R3推导至A1–A4的分析性论证，并坦承其性质为"概念卫生"而非"必然性定理"；（d）将当前LLM中心实践定位为"高能力但低成熟度"；（e）将四项研究问题（RQ1–RQ4）明确提出作为未来实证议程。

Conclusion: 论证结论：纵向临床推理应在架构层面而非模型层面解决；问责性强制要求持久、可治理的证据账本与独立于证据的信念状态；当前LLM临床系统的局限是"接口"而非"内部表征"，因此单纯依靠提示工程、检索增强、微调或扩展上下文窗口无法实现可问责性。论文将"可问责临床AI"从口号转化为审计工具，并以此为后续研究规划了证据层（生产中）、信念层（工程中）、完整临床世界模型（研究中）的递进实现路径。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become the dominant interface of clinical artificial intelligence, yet the interface they expose (text in, text out, one context window at a time) maintains no explicit, persistent, governed representation of what is currently true about a patient. This paper argues that longitudinal clinical reasoning is a state-estimation problem under partial observability, and that the axis on which clinical AI succeeds or fails is not the fluency of the model reading the record but the governance of the patient state it reasons over. We distinguish generated context from governed state; separate five objects that clinical AI habitually conflates (true state, observations, evidence, belief, and simulated state); define a tiered governance standard against which any clinical AI system can be audited; and show that an operational definition of accountability decomposes into four information requirements: an immutable evidence ledger with awareness-time versioning, a belief state distinct from accumulated evidence, an observation-process model, and claim-level causal typing. We are explicit that this decomposition is analytic rather than a necessity theorem, and that its value is conceptual hygiene: it converts "accountable clinical AI" from a slogan into an audit instrument. A six-level maturity framework separates what a system makes governable from what it can compute, locating current LLM-centric practice at high capability but low maturity. The paper is fully self-contained: the four research questions the framework poses are stated in the introduction, and the conclusion records what the paper establishes toward each; future work develops the buildable core of the architecture and the research program toward full Clinical World Models. No empirical result is claimed here.

</details>


### [448] [Do LLMs Know What to Ask and When? Evaluating Multi-Turn Information Seeking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14808)
*Yepeng Huang,Jiawen Zhang,Michelle Dai,Xiaorui Su,Shanghua Gao,Zi Wang,Marinka Zitnik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将多轮信息寻求形式化为 k-欠约束约束满足问题（CSP），构建了涵盖 5 个领域、5,251 道问题的 MT-InfoSeek 评测套件。研究发现：当前大语言模型（LLM）能识别信息不足但严重低估缺失程度（k=2 时少估概率是多估的 4 倍），常在获取充分信息前过早停止；查询顺序错误会显著降低最终准确率；信息寻求能力与答案生成能力相互独立，传统的最终准确率无法捕捉该能力差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多轮交互中，用户问题常存在欠约束（underspecification）现象。现有评测主要衡量最终任务完成度（如 MediQ 中 30B 模型仅凭部分信息即可达到 60-70% 准确率），混淆了模型对先验知识的利用与真正的信息寻求能力。因此亟需一种将"是否获取了确定答案所需信息"与"是否生成正确答案"解耦的评测方法，以系统评估 LLM 的交互式信息寻求能力。

Method: 1. 形式化：将多轮信息寻求建模为 k-欠约束 CSP P=⟨X,D,C,A,Y⟩，引入充分集、极小 k-充分集（k-MSS）、任务级与问题级欠约束度等概念。2. 评测协议：三级分离评估——(a) k 预测（识别信息缺失量）、(b) k-MSS 识别（选择极小查询集）、(c) 序贯多轮求解（与预言机交互）。3. MT-InfoSeek 套件：包含 Logic-Q-MT、GSME-Q-MT/-Ext、GeneReg-MT、ClinGuide-MT、20Q 五个领域，共 5,251 道题、9,006 任务实例，k∈{1,2,3,4}。4. 核心指标：最终充分性（final sufficiency）——无论最终答案对错，所获信息是否唯一确定目标变量。5. 被测模型：GPT-5、GPT-5-mini、Gemini-3-Flash、Qwen3 系列、gpt-oss 等 14 个模型，使用对抗式预言机。

Result: 1. 性能随 k 增大单调下降；k=2 时模型低估缺失程度的发生率约为高估的 4 倍。2. 即使告知真实 k，模型对 k≥2 的极小充分集准确率仍低于 0.2。3. 模型常在信息充分前过早停止（如 20Q 中 GPT-5-mini 18 轮后仍失败）。4. ClinGuide-MT 中查询顺序错误使最终准确率降低，即使最终获取了所有必需信息。5. 首轮错误常可恢复（首轮失误+第二轮命中组与首轮命中组充分性接近，差距<10pp）。6. 20Q 分析：信息增益高的问题不必然带来高准确率；强模型在压缩候选空间后难以区分相近目标。7. 最佳模型：GPT-5、GPT-5-mini、Gemini-3.1-Pro 在结构化领域表现最优；GPT-5 在 20Q Common 达 54% 准确率。8. 强制模型在 k 轮前必须查询可显著提升 Qwen 系列（+9.7pp 至 +25.7pp），但不影响强模型。

Conclusion: 多轮信息寻求能力与答案生成能力相互独立，传统的最终准确率指标无法捕捉这一维度。MT-InfoSeek 通过引入最终充分性指标实现了二者的解耦：模型可能因先验猜测答对但未获取充分信息，也可能获取了充分信息但答错。该研究主张 LLM 评测应同时记录：模型是否识别欠约束、应查询哪些变量、是否在多轮中获取了这些变量。未来工作可拓展至含噪、不一致的更丰富用户模型、概率化不确定性以及缺失规则型欠约束等场景。

Abstract: When a user question is underspecified, a capable model should recognize that its context is insufficient, identify the missing information, ask for it, and respond only once that information determines a unique answer. We formalize multi-turn information seeking as solving a k-underspecified constraint satisfaction problem, where k is the number of variables jointly required to determine the target and therefore measures the degree of missing information. We instantiate the formulation in MT-InfoSeek, a controlled evaluation suite of 5,251 problems and 9,006 task instances spanning mathematics, logic, biology, medicine, and general knowledge. We evaluate models along three axes: what they ask, when they ask it, and how the acquired information affects the final answer. Performance degrades across models and domains as underspecification increases. Models recognize that additional information is needed but underestimate how much, and in logical problems at k = 2 they under-predict the degree of missing information about four times as often as they over-predict it. They also fail to identify a minimal sufficient set of queries, improve only marginally when given the true k, and often stop before acquiring sufficient information. In tasks with ordered dependencies, an incorrect query order reduces final accuracy even when the model eventually acquires all necessary information. We measure information seeking directly through final sufficiency, which records whether the acquired information determines the target independent of answer generation. This separation shows differences between models that final accuracy alone does not capture, and indicates that the ability to seek information over multiple turns is distinct from the ability to generate answers and is not measured by current LLM evaluations.

</details>


### [449] [MINT: Min-Selection Preference Distillation for Balanced Multi-Objective Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14828)
*Tony Tu,Sayan Chakraborty,Ruomeng Xu,Tony Qin,Austin Tian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MINT（MIN-selection preference disTillation），通过对偏好蒸馏中的偏好对选择规则进行极简修改——使用候选回复最弱目标函数的最小值（min-selection）而非加权求和来排序——解决多目标对齐中加性标量化导致的"搭便车"崩溃问题。该方法是广义幂均值族M_p在p→-∞时的极限，在静态和交互式评估中均显著提升了两类相反对话场景（合作型情感支持ESConv、对抗性价格谈判CraigslistBargain）的弱轴表现并降低目标间不平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于人类反馈的偏好训练（RLHF/DPO）通常将多个目标加性组合为单一标量奖励，导致优化过程倾向于"最易提升"的目标而牺牲其他——例如情感支持代理学会"听起来温暖"却提供不了实质性帮助。这种结构性缺陷根源于加性标量化缺乏对"平衡"的内在感知。

Method: MINT对标准best-of-K偏好蒸馏流程仅做"一行修改"：对每条对话轮采样K=8个候选回复，用冻结LLM裁判在两个正交目标（AQ行动商数/EQ情感商数）上分别打分，通过广义幂均值M_p(a,b)在线排序——取p→-∞极限即min(AQ,EQ)作为标量分数，被选回复为最平衡候选，被拒回复为最偏斜候选；剩余DPO损失、参考策略、采样流程均不变。附加机制包括小margin阈值过滤、stance提示用以多样化候选但蒸馏后丢弃、LoRA微调、严格匹配前缀的静态与全轮交互式两种评估。

Result: 在ESConv上MINT将弱轴min(AQ,EQ)从SFT的0.37提升至0.64（Wilcoxon p≈3×10⁻43，79%配对轮次胜出），同时将|AQ-EQ|从0.26降至0.16，且比人类专家更平衡；在CraigslistBargain上将min从0.583提至0.657（p=0.0002），差距从0.177收窄至0.135。逐轮分析揭示核心规律：MINT对参考策略不平衡的修正幅度正比于该参考的不平衡程度，并在多轮交互中持续存在——对抗崩溃的SFT参考时全10轮均显著（p<10⁻4），但面对已较平衡的base参考时，开局显著（Δmin=+0.077, p=0.016）后优势随对话推进单调衰减至turn 8的+0.001即不显著。

Conclusion: MINT不是一种普适的提升手段，而是对参考策略多目标不平衡的精确校正器：显著且持久的增益出现在参考策略存在显著的、持续的不平衡之处；当参考已近平衡时，开局匹配轮次仍显著，但开放轨迹的策略收敛会令优势消退。这一定位比聚合平均数更忠实于方法本身的机制——"木桶短板"校准器。

Abstract: Aligning a language agent to several objectives at once is a persistent failure mode of preference-based training: when objectives are combined additively, optimization collapses onto whichever is cheapest to improve and sacrifices the rest, so a support agent learns to sound warm while giving no real help. The root issue is that an additive reward has no notion of balance. We introduce Mint (MIN-selection preference disTillation), a one-line change to preference distillation: rather than ranking sampled candidates by a weighted sum of rewards, we rank them by their weakest objective, distilling the best-balanced candidate over the most lopsided one with an unchanged DPO objective. This is the p -> negative infinity limit of a generalized-mean family spanning additive to worst-case selection. Across cooperative emotional support and adversarial negotiation, min-selection lifts both objectives while sharply cutting their imbalance; on emotional support it raises the weaker axis from 0.37 to 0.64 (p < 10^-40), surpassing human experts and persisting across full multi-turn rollouts. A turn-by-turn analysis yields our central finding: min-selection corrects imbalance in proportion to how imbalanced the reference policy is, and its benefit endures over an interaction precisely as long as that imbalance does.

</details>


### [450] [What the Reranker Sees: Multi-Aspect Page Annotation for Long-Document Multimodal Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14841)
*Guanchen Wu,Jiayuan Ding,Subhabrata Mukherjee,Carl Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Trident 是一种用于长文档多模态视觉问答（VQA）的两阶段检索-阅读流水线，通过在检索阶段引入多视角结构化页面标注（Trident-R），在生成阶段引入多视角 VLM 提示（Trident-S），显著提升了长文档中证据页的筛选与答案合成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在长文档多模态问答中，传统"检索-读取"流水线面临瓶颈：检索召回率虽高（如 BGE-M3 Recall@20=0.86），但在 top-20 候选池中精准识别证据页时 F1@5 极低（0.254~0.332）。根本原因在于重排序阶段的纯文本 LLM 只能看到原始文本片段，无法感知表格、图表、布局等关键视觉证据；而现有解决方案（如让多模态 LLM 直接看图片）成本高昂且需训练。论文旨在探索一种低成本、训练无关的"标注接口"方案。

Method: Trident 包含两个互补组件：(1) **Trident-R**：离线为每页生成多视角结构化标注（视觉描述、章节路径、实体标签、主题/实体/结构三轴概念命中），将候选页打包为 JSON 语义记录，由 LLM 单次自适应 K 选完成重排序，与上游检索器无关；(2) **Trident-S**：在生成阶段，对同一组页面图像并行采用主题(T)、实体/数值(E)、结构/章节(S)三个视角提示 VLM，再由合成调用整合三种候选答案。视觉描述由 GPT-4o-mini 离线生成，文本嵌入用 text-embedding-3-large，重排序与生成用 GPT-4.1。

Result: 在 MMLongBench-Doc 的 830 个可回答 QA 上，标注+重排序协议使五种异构检索池（BM25、RRF、BGE-M3、xKG、ColPali）的 F1 全部超过 PageIndex 基线，BGE-M3 从 0.254 提升至 0.546，ColPali 从 0.332 提升至 0.581；在 LongDocURL（N=1122）外部迁移验证中 Trident-R 同样取得最高 F1（0.398）。机制消融表明：(1) 仅文本片段的 LLM 重排序几乎不改变首命中排名（MRR 不变甚至下降），排序提升必须依赖结构化标注；(2) 视觉描述本身即可恢复绝大部分增益（~90%），且效果在文本/视觉检索池间近乎一致，证实其本质是"语义接口"而非简单模态补全。(3) 端到端 QA 中 ColPali+标注+重排序+Trident-S 取得最强答案准确率（GPT-4.1 judge 53.7%，Claude judge 52.7%），两评判者排序一致（κ=0.913）；Trident-S 在开放性合成题上增益 +1.7~+6.6 分，在 MCQ/抽取题上无影响。脱帽分析、补帽一致性与答案泄露审计共同支撑结论稳健性。

Conclusion: 论文揭示了长文档多模态 QA 中"重排序接口瓶颈"——证据选择能力取决于重排序器能从候选页中"看到"什么，而非检索器层面的视觉编码能力。Trident-R 以低成本离线结构化标注取代昂贵的多模态重排序器，使纯文本 LLM 即可有效利用多模态证据；Trident-S 则将多视角分析范式延伸至生成阶段。整套方案训练无关、检索器无关、可即插即用，偏移了长文档 QA 研究从"检索器如何打分"到"重排序器能看到什么"的关注焦点。

Abstract: Long-document visual question answering (VQA) over documents of tens to hundreds of pages mixing text, tables, charts, and figures typically follows retrieve-then-read pipelines. In our setting, the bottleneck shifts from retrieval recall to reranker-side evidence selection: on MMLongBench-Doc, BGE-M3 reaches Recall@20 = 0.86 but only F1@5 = 0.254, and even the visual retriever ColPali reaches only F1@5 = 0.332; a text-only rerank LLM seeing only raw snippets misses table, chart, and layout evidence even when the upstream retriever encoded images. We propose Trident, with two complementary components: Trident-R, a retriever-agnostic LLM reranker that converts each candidate into an LLM-readable semantic record, including a visual caption, section path, entity tags, multi-axis concept hits, and a text snippet, then performs a single adaptive-K rerank call; and Trident-S, a generation-side module that prompts the VLM under topical, entity, and structural lenses before synthesis. On two long-document datasets, the annotation+rerank protocol substantially improves retrieval F1 across five heterogeneous pools, with every reranked pool exceeding the strongest adaptive-K baseline PageIndex. An LLM rerank without the annotation barely changes first-hit ranking, indicating the lift comes from the structured annotation. Trident-S targets open-ended synthesis questions by design, adding up to 6.6 points in generation accuracy on these questions. The best Trident configuration is the strongest downstream QA pipeline in our evaluation, with rankings consistent across two LLM judges (kappa = 0.913).

</details>


### [451] [Discovering High-Quality Chess Puzzles with Offline Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14851)
*Allen Nie,Anirudhan Badrinath,Nicholas Tomlin,Timothy Dai,Carissa Yip,Rose E Wang,Emma Brunskill,Chris Piech*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文利用Chess.com上一年的15亿条解题记录（共310万用户、44.1万道题目），提出一种基于离线强化学习的国际象棋谜题推荐策略，通过优势加权actor-critic目标训练Transformer架构的策略网络，旨在自动筛选并推荐具有高教学价值的谜题，显著改善初学者（Elo 100–1000）的学习体验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线国际象棋平台（如Chess.com、Lichess）依赖启发式策略（分桶均匀采样）从海量自动生成的谜题中推荐题目，但这些谜题普遍被认为教学价值偏低。传统专家精心编纂的高质量谜题数量有限，而自动生成题目的教学价值难以评估。论文旨在利用大规模用户交互数据，自动学习谜题的教学价值并构建个性化推荐策略，特别是帮助那些学习停滞的初学者。

Method: 1. 数据层面：使用Chess.com 2021年3月至2022年3月的15亿条解题记录，将用户按Elo区间划分为"增长组"与"停滞组"。2. 算法层面：基于优势加权actor-critic（AWR）框架推导离线策略学习目标（结合KL散度约束保证不偏离行为策略过远），使用期望回归训练价值网络、TD误差训练动作价值函数。3. 架构层面：采用因果Transformer作为决策策略π_θ，用户特征（Elo、正确率）经MLP编码，谜题特征（棋盘位置CNN编码+谜题ID嵌入+首步嵌入）经MLP+CNN编码，通过指数化内积实现温度加权的softmax策略，并以minibatch负采样近似归一化。4. 奖励函数：基于"正确率×exp(α·Elo差)"的难度加权正确性奖励。5. 评估方法：使用单步重要性采样（截断权重[0.1, 10]）进行离线策略评估；招募8位持证专家构建标注体系，并基于DSPy用专家标注微调LLM作为评分裁判。

Result: 1. 离线策略评估：在Elo 100–600区间，训练策略相较Chess.com原策略在停滞组上从14.3提升至52.9（增长组从17.7提升至58.8）；Elo 600–1000区间也取得统计显著的提升（停滞组14.1→27.0）。Elo超过1000后改进逐渐消失，策略趋于中性。整体上，80%以上用户集中在1500 Elo以下，该群体平均提升约110.1%。2. 专家/LLM评估：训练策略推荐的谜题在"趣味性"（+4.77，p<0.01）和"难度匹配"（+4.78，p<0.05）上显著优于原策略，在计算量、模式识别、质量上略有提升，信息量持平。3. 定性观察：策略倾向于推荐比原系统稍难且更具趣味性的谜题。

Conclusion: 该研究验证了离线强化学习可有效从海量用户行为数据中挖掘国际象棋谜题的教学价值，证明数据驱动方法能在大规模教育场景中超越人工设计的启发式策略。该流水线有望推广到数学、语言学习、编程等其他教学领域；但受限于伦理与实验条件，尚缺乏随机对照试验的直接人类评估，未来需与平台合作开展真实部署验证。

Abstract: Learning and skill mastery require extensive and deliberate practice. In many learning settings, producing high-quality pedagogical materials can require a high level of domain expertise and be very time-consuming. Pedagogical materials often need to train students to engage in different thinking patterns. In some domains, such as chess, puzzles are used to help students practice their skills in calculating the next moves and recognizing known patterns on a board. Giving students a practice set of puzzles to help them learn different modes of thinking is challenging because the teacher needs to carefully balance between different motifs and how many look-ahead steps a student needs to perform. Popular online platforms like this http URL and Lichess offer players millions of puzzles. Unlike chess tactics puzzles procured by human experts, where chess beginners can learn valuable insights, these puzzles are automatically generated and often regarded as having low pedagogical value. These platforms also rely on a heuristic to recommend puzzles to users for practice. Using the user history data over an entire year, a total of 1.5 billion puzzle-solving histories, we learn the pedagogical value of a puzzle and how to automatically choose a set of puzzles to better support chess learners using insights from offline reinforcement learning. We show that using offline policy evaluation, our trained policy has significant impact on beginners with puzzle-solving Elo range of 100--1000, particularly for the group of beginners whose learning growth was stagnant. We also performed a qualitative analysis of the puzzles discovered by our model by collecting annotation ratings from expert chess players. The success of our pipeline shows promise for a future where we can understand the pedagogical values of practice items given general user interaction data.

</details>


### [452] [JarvisBench: Always-on Intelligence Between Humans and Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14870)
*Chen Chen,Zhehuai Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: JarvisBench 是一个用于评估人与长期运行智能体之间双向注意力协调的基准，包含 45 个任务实例（20 个单智能体任务 + 25 个多智能体工作流组成 10 个项目），覆盖 19 个领域。其核心思想是引入一个"始终在线"的中间层 Jarvis，介导用户对一个或多个工作智能体之间的注意力分配，并设有两个评估轨道：智能体协作轨道（评估代理能否在关键时刻请求用户判断以提升任务结果）和用户交互轨道（评估代理能否及时准确地回答用户关于进行中工作的提问）。参考实现还提供了全双工语音接口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着长时程智能体自主执行能力的提升，出现了双向注意力错配问题：(1) 用户在智能体工作时想要提问或提供指导，必须打断其执行；(2) 智能体遇到需要人类判断的关键决策时，无法确保用户正在关注，往往只能猜测并继续。现有智能体主要针对任务完成度训练，缺乏对"何时应引入间歇性可用的用户"的校准能力。同时现有研究（如 Codex、Qoder）虽朝此方向迈进，但缺乏评估该双向注意力协调问题的基准。

Method: 1. 基准构建：从 69 个现有智能体基准中审计并筛选出 2,038 个候选任务，最终选取 45 个改编任务，确保初始提示包含足够信息，但关键决策点会在执行过程中自然产生。2. 双角色架构：用户（由 LLM 模拟，持有私有信息）—— Jarvis（外部中间层，观察有界任务事件，不修改智能体执行循环）—— 工作智能体（冻结的执行环境）。3. 评估协议：  
- 智能体协作轨道：固定加权检查点得出 0-100 的任务结果分数；定义"注意力效率"为每请求一次用户获得的平均分数增益。  
- 用户交互轨道：采用因果回放协议，工作智能体轨迹仅记录一次并按时间顺序对 Jarvis 回放；在约 25% 和 75% 检查点设置通用问题，并由 GPT-5.6-Luna 生成跟进问题；评分分为 0/1/2 三级。  
4. 参考实现：集成 Qwen3-ASR、Silero VAD、Kokoro-82M TTS 的全双工语音接口，支持 0.8 秒持续语音的打断机制。5. 实验设置：固定 GPT-5.6-Sol 作为 Jarvis 评估 6 种工作智能体；固定 Claude Opus 4.8 作为工作智能体评估 4 种 Jarvis LLM。

Result: 1. 工作智能体兼容性：GPT-5.6-Sol 作为 Jarvis 可使所有完成评估的工作智能体获得提升，单智能体任务提升 4.9–24.7 分，多智能体任务提升 12.5–28.2 分；Claude Opus 4.8 + Jarvis 增益最大（单智能体 +24.1，多智能体 +28.2），但 GPT-5.6-Sol + GPT-5.6-Sol 增益最小（单智能体仅 +4.9）。  
2. Jarvis LLM 对比：GPT-5.6-Sol 在两种任务拓扑上均取得最大分数增益和最高最终得分；DeepSeek V4-Pro 在多智能体任务上注意力效率最高（0.41），因其仅需 0.30 次请求即可获得显著增益。  
3. 用户交互：GPT-5.6-Sol 总体交互分最高 96.3，延迟 1.8 秒；GPT-OSS-120B 延迟最低 1.3 秒（本地部署），Claude Opus 4.8 总体评分 90.8，DeepSeek V4-Pro 85.8；各模型在不同指标上呈现权衡。  
4. 关键发现：干预强度存在权衡——更多请求可能带来更高任务分数，但消耗人类注意力并可能干扰工作智能体执行。

Conclusion: JarvisBench 证实了注意力协调既有用又技术上具有挑战性：(1) 外部 Jarvis 层可在不修改 OpenClaw 框架的前提下改善各种工作智能体表现；(2) GPT-5.6-Sol 是提升任务结果的默认最强 Jarvis LLM，但较小模型在注意力效率上可能更具优势；(3) GPT-5.6-Sol 同时提供最佳用户交互体验。论文强调该原型是参考控制系统而非最终设计：干预强度的最优工作点取决于任务质量、响应时间和人类注意力三者之间的权衡。未来的智能体运行时、干预策略、交互模型和语音接口均可基于此评估协议进行比较，因为将任务执行与注意力协调解耦为智能体能力持续提升提供了稳定评估目标。

Abstract: Long-horizon agents can execute continuously, but human attention remains intermittent and scarce. This creates a bidirectional coordination problem: users may need immediate access to an agent while work continues in the background, whereas agents may encounter consequential decisions that require user judgment after the user has stopped monitoring execution. We posit an always-on attention-coordination layer---\textit{Jarvis}\footnote{Named after the fictional AI assistant in \textit{Iron Man}.}---that mediates this interface and allocates human attention across one or more working agents. We introduce \textit{JarvisBench} to evaluate both directions of this coordination: whether an intermediary can accurately and promptly answer user-initiated questions about ongoing work, and whether it can recognize when an agent requires user judgment, solicit that judgment at the right moment, and route it back to improve task outcomes. JarvisBench contains 45 agentic task instances: 20 single-agent tasks and 25 workstreams organized into 10 multi-agent projects. The tasks span 19 domains and were selected and adapted from more than 2,000 public candidates. Crucially, the need for user attention arises naturally during execution rather than from an obvious omission in the initial prompt. JarvisBench is designed to integrate with arbitrary agent runtimes without modifying their underlying execution loops. Our reference implementation further provides a full-duplex speech interface, allowing users to reach Jarvis naturally while timely attention coordination supports agents working in the background. By separating agent execution from attention coordination, JarvisBench provides a stable evaluation target as agent capabilities continue to improve.

</details>


### [453] [Personalized Auto-Research: Towards a True AI Co-Scientist](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14881)
*Bo Ni,Franck Dernoncourt,Hongjie Chen,Yu Wang,Nesreen K. Ahmed,Zhengzhong Tu,Tyler Derr,Ryan A. Rossi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"个性化自动研究"（Personalized Auto-Research）问题，定义了在AI科研助手的每个阶段（检索、假设搜索、实验、写作、审稿）都需以研究者个人表征为条件的范式，并提出了一个基于图结构的研究者上下文框架，目标是使AI成为真正的"合著者"而非通用工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI合著者系统（如AI Scientist、AI Scientist-v2等）均为"研究者无关"（researcher-agnostic），即对同一研究目标，无论使用者是博士生还是资深教授，输出几乎一致。这忽视了科学发现中一个根本事实：新颖性、价值与可行性高度依赖研究者的过往工作、方法论积累、协作者网络和所属社区。由此带来的风险包括：认知层面（大量隐性知识无法从文献中获取）、系统层面（导致科研趋同化、monoculture）、实践层面（方向与研究者能力不匹配）。作者认为个性化不是便利层，而是AI成为真正合著者的根本属性。

Method: 提出了一个通用框架（Algorithm 1），包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于异构图𝒢的研究者表征——通过图编码器Enc_𝒢从研究者节点的多跳邻域中学习z_u，并结合观察信号𝒮_u经Φ生成上下文c_u；(2) 全流程个性化——将c_u注入到每个阶段：检索采用s_u(d|g)=⟨η(d), ρ(g,c_u)⟩联合打分；假设搜索在用户条件化的树ℬ_u上进行，效用函数U(h|g,u)=α·Nov+β·Rel+γ·Feas三者均依赖c_u；实验实现、视觉评审、写作、引用精炼、审稿均以c_u为条件；可选人机反馈被并入𝒮_u并重新编码，实现跨会话持续更新；(3) 面向个体的评估——提出以"保真度"（能否还原被屏蔽论文路径）和"对比度"（不同上下文对同一概念是否产生分化输出）作为必要条件指标。最终输出为可复现的研究包𝒬_u=(h, U, 𝒞, 𝒪, ℱ, y, v, Λ_u, c_u, ℛ_u(g))。

Result: 作为一篇定位论文（position paper），未报告实证结果。其"结果"体现在概念层面：(a) 形式化了个性化自动研究问题，区分了它与现有AI合著者系统及个性化语言模型工作（前者自动化但忽略研究者，后者个性化单次输出但不针对科研决策序列）；(b) 通过表1明确了"个性化"与"自主性"是正交轴，并指出"真正AI合著者"应处于"个性化+人在环"象限；(c) 揭示了"一刀切"失败模式——同一目标对不同研究者产生几乎相同的输出，抹杀了科学创造力的异质性来源；(d) 提出了团队个性化扩展（用子图T⊆𝒰替代单用户u，并讨论了可行性取并集、对齐取交集的不对称聚合）、冷启动与生命周期差异、以及创造力坍塌等关键开放问题。

Conclusion: 作者将个性化自动研究定位为AI生态系统的重大挑战，跨越图学习、代理系统、HCI和社区基准。其核心论断是：系统若不了解合作对象就无法成为真正的合著者；目标应是互补性而非相似性——更强大的通用引擎无法解决问题，因为它仍向所有人返回相同的方案；个性化是正交且必需的。论文呼吁建设面向个体评估的基准基础设施，并强调围绕新颖性、公平性、隐私、生命周期和评估的张力定义了此领域，算法本身同等重要。

Abstract: AI co-scientists that generate hypotheses, retrieve related work, design experiments, execute code, and draft full papers are beginning to change how research is carried out. Despite this rapid progress, state-of-the-art systems remain researcher-agnostic: given a research goal, they optimize novelty, validity, or reviewer score while ignoring the individual scientist who will use the output. This overlooks a fundamental fact about research, namely, that what counts as novel, valuable, or feasible depends on the researcher, including their prior work, methodological repertoire, and the collaborators and communities in which they are embedded. In this work, we introduce the problem of personalized auto-research, which conditions every stage of the research process on a representation of the individual researcher. We argue that personalization is not a convenience layer, but rather the fundamental property that allows an AI system to serve as a genuine co-scientist rather than a generic instrument. To address this problem, we propose a general and flexible framework that threads a graph-grounded researcher context through retrieval, hypothesis search, experimentation, writing, and review. The framework consists of three fundamental components: (i) graph-grounded researcher representations, (ii) personalization across the full research pipeline, and (iii) evaluation grounded in the individual. Notably, we highlight a one-size-fits-all failure mode where distinct researchers issuing the same goal receive essentially the same research, erasing the tacit knowledge through which novel ideas arise. Finally, we discuss fundamental open problems and challenges.

</details>


### [454] [Frontier AI Forecasting Has a Measurement Problem: An Audit of Progress Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14903)
*Fabricio F Costa*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文审计了用于前沿AI预测的公开测量记录的可靠性。作者构建了一个以事件为中心、冻结于2026年8月12日的审计样本（62个系统、12个版本化基准、144个事件），发现公开记录存在三个核心预测瓶颈：联合观测稀疏（仅7个系统同时拥有训练算力与METR任务时长数据）、基准链接不确定性（基准版本更替导致尺度漂移）、以及来源高度集中（73.2%的量化事件来自METR一个项目）。论文主张：可辩护的日期预测本质上是对版本化测量系统的科学主张，而非简单拟合曲线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿AI预测通常将日期目标与基准分数、训练算力、发布时间或专家信念的趋势联系起来。然而这些预测的有效性取决于若干前提条件：目标构念明确、观测可比、进展变量联合观测、以及不确定性模型纳入测量工具变化。作者尝试构建基于事件的预测时发现，支撑基础设施可建，但进展分析无法在不强假设下识别——这是测量问题而非软件问题。动机是审计这些前提条件在公开记录中是否成立。

Method: 1) 建立冻结证据库（2026年8月12日为截止日），62个精选系统（27闭源+35开源权重）；2) 采用事件中心表示法，规范化12个基准版本、7个准则、27个来源、144个事件、408个类型化关系，构成可重现的语义图；3) 五个审计问题：构念明确性、预测变量与结果的联合观测、基准版本链接、协议与资源记录、以及来源与不确定性；4) 三类实证检验：联合观测稀疏性分析、对数/对数比/线性/概率比尺度下的基准链接OLS回归、最小可检测偏离(MDE)的统计功效分析；5) 对56个外部来源（29篇同行评审+27篇预印本/标准报告/官方发布）进行系统性编码，识别16个互补测量方向。

Result: 三个关键结果：(1) 联合观测瓶颈——仅7个系统同时拥有训练算力和METR 50%任务时长；19/27闭源系统缺失算力数据，全部35个开源权重系统缺失METR时长数据；缺失非随机，与访问制度相关；(2) 测量工具变化与来源集中——52/71（73.2%）的实质性量化事件来自METR单一项目，来源赫芬达尔指数为0.542（相当于仅1.85个等效独立来源），76.1%为实验室发布；(3) 基准链接的尺度依赖性——METR 1.0→1.1在log₂尺度下斜率为1.206（95% CI 1.021–1.390），非平移关系；MMLU→MMLU-Pro在logit下为0.976、probit下为1.043、线性下为1.312、对数下为1.984，结论取决于所选链接；现有设计功效仅63%（METR）和6%（MMLU），检测10%偏离需23–31个共同系统。补充结果是16个测量方向的组合框架（资源、推理预算、可靠性、自主性、安全、人类偏好、领域结果、回测），无单一标量可替代全部。

Conclusion: 前沿AI预测的真正问题不是"无法预测"，而是缺乏"共同标尺"。论文主张应将预测视为关于版本化测量系统（其连接、协议、链接、来源依赖）的复合科学主张，而非仅拟合曲线或日历日期。可辩护的预测数据包应包含：操作化目标、基准版本与链接函数、确切模型配置（脚手架/工具/评判者/推理预算）、支撑进展关系的联合观测与缺失模型、来源依赖与独立复制、以及基于适当评分规则的冻结回测协议。所需的是包含9项跨切设计要求的版本化测量组合，而非又一个万能排行榜分数。最精确的部分可能是日期，最不精确的部分可能是路径上测量的对象本身。

Abstract: Quantitative forecasts of frontier artificial intelligence often connect dated targets to trends in benchmark scores, training compute, release time, or expert belief. This paper audits whether the public measurement record supports those connections before another trend is fitted. I construct a frozen, event-centric record through 12 August 2026 with 62 selected systems, 12 versioned benchmarks, seven capability or impact criteria, 144 graded events, 27 source records, and 408 typed relations. The record is an audit sample, not a census. Only seven systems jointly observe estimated training compute and a METR 50 percent task horizon. Training compute is absent for 19 of 27 closed systems, including every selected closed release from 2026, while none of the 35 open-weight systems has a METR horizon observation. Benchmark succession creates a second break: a seven-system link from METR Time Horizon 1.0 to 1.1 has a log-scale slope of 1.206 (95 percent CI 1.021 to 1.390), whereas a six-system MMLU to MMLU-Pro comparison appears shift-like under logit and probit links but not under linear or logarithmic links. The observed bridges have about 80 percent power only for slope departures near 25 percent. Provenance is concentrated: 52 of 71 substantive quantitative events, or 73.2 percent, come from one measurement programme, and 76.1 percent are laboratory releases. A review of 56 methodological and empirical sources identifies 16 complementary measurement directions spanning resources, inference budgets, reliability, agentic work, safety, human preference, field outcomes, and forecast backtesting. No direction supplies a replacement scalar. The result is not that frontier AI forecasting is impossible, but that a defensible dated forecast is a claim about a versioned measurement system with explicit joins, protocols, links, and source dependence, not merely a fitted curve or calendar date.

</details>


### [455] [LLMs Can Predict Failure Risk, But Struggle to Predict Which Collaboration Protocol Pays Off: Cost-Aware Protocol Routing Across Reasoning Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14927)
*Chih-Hsuan Yang,Jingyan Jiang,Cheng-Hau Yang,Vikram Vasudevan,Huihuo Zheng,Venkatram Vishwanath,Rajeev Thakur*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究了多智能体LLM系统中的成本感知协议路由问题：何时升级协作协议是值得的。作者在4,181道数学竞赛题上对比了四种协议（Baseline直接求解、Single自校正、PER规划-执行-审查、Broadcast多智能体审议），发现：(1) 失败风险预测效果良好（AUROC 0.8847）；(2) 但对具体协议价值的预测能力很弱（AUPRC降至0.10–0.17）；(3) 自置信度门控可有效支持初始升级决策（78.0%解决率/45K tokens），但协议特定的成本感知路由仍未解决，与固定顺序oracle相比仍存在18.5–28.9点的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统通过增加计算量提升推理能力，但部署时需决定"何时"以及"哪个"协作协议值得其边际成本。现有路由评估的准确率指标会掩盖方向性错误：保守策略倾向于不升级而遗漏可解决的问题，高求解率的冻结LLM路由器则倾向于过度升级造成token浪费。论文明确区分两个不同问题——失败风险预测（Baseline是否会错）与协作价值预测（哪个更强协议能带来足够收益）——后者仍是开放问题。

Method: 构建匹配基准：4,181道Omni-MATH 2竞赛级数学题，每题在四种协议（Baseline、Single、PER、Broadcast）下各运行一次，固定求解器为gpt-oss-120b。对比固定策略、元数据启发式、学习型路由器（文本+元数据逻辑回归）、冻结LLM路由器（gpt-oss-120b/Llama/Gemma）。关键设计：(1) 固定顺序oracle（按成本序Baseline→Single→PER→Broadcast→None的首个成功动作）作为回顾性上界；(2) 答案后、前协作前的置信度探针预测Baseline失败；(3) 答案前自评估探针用作自置信度门控；(4) 扩展到四个基准（OmniMath/JEEBench/SciBench/LAB-Bench）和两个求解器家族的10种配对设置进行稳健性检验。评估指标包括解决率、平均tokens、相对oracle的过量tokens以及欠升级/过升级比例。

Result: (1) 答案后探针在gpt-oss OmniMath上预测Baseline失败的AUROC达0.8847（95% CI [0.8732, 0.8955]），ECE 0.0852；(2) 同一探针预测"任意协作有帮助"的AUPRC为0.7683，但预测PER首成功的AUPRC骤降至0.1674，Broadcast独占成功的AUPRC仅0.1041；(3) 自置信度门控以78.0%解决率/45K tokens优于冻结gpt-oss路由器的73.8%/71.3K；(4) 在10种配对设置中oracle比Baseline高出23.2–58.3点，但协议剖面随任务变化（Broadcast在9种设置中最强，PER在Gemma SciBench上强2.7点）；(5) 6种保留路由器评估中oracle差距仍达18.5–28.9点；(6) 条件于Baseline和Single同时失败时，Broadcast比Per高9.6–44.6点（领域依赖），但PER独占成功在每种设置中均存在（2.4–11.1%）。

Conclusion: 论文得出诊断性结论而非宣称解决完整路由问题：失败风险估计对决定是否保留廉价直接求解器有用，但协作价值估计还需预测哪种昂贵工作流能提供足够边际收益。保守与激进路由器方向相反地失败，二值门控仅覆盖第一个决策，保留路由器与oracle之间存在较大差距。结论：同模型置信度可支持初始"停留或升级"门控，但在Single/PER/Broadcast/None中选择仍是成本感知控制问题，需要进一步研究。论文通过基准、方向性错误分析以及明确的失败风险/协议价值区分，为这一开放问题提供了可测量的目标。

Abstract: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems can improve reasoning by spending more computation, but deployment requires deciding when extra collaboration is worth its cost. We isolate this decision by running every problem under four protocols while holding the solver fixed within each setting: direct solving (Baseline), iterative self-correction (Single), planner-executor-reviewer collaboration (PER), and multi-agent deliberation (Broadcast). The primary benchmark comprises 4,181 competition-level math problems; paired robustness checks cover four benchmarks spanning competition math, biology, and broader science with two solver families. Across fixed policies, trained routers, and frozen LLM routers, conservative policies under-escalate, whereas higher-solve frozen routers often over-escalate. A post-answer, pre-collaboration gpt-oss-120b probe ranks Baseline failures with 0.8847 AUROC (4,151 parseable cases; 95% CI [0.8732, 0.8955]). The same score remains informative for predicting whether any collaboration helps (0.7683 AUPRC), but is much weaker for identifying PER- or Broadcast-specific value (0.1674 and 0.1041 AUPRC). Separately, the pre-answer self-confidence gate reaches 78.0% solve at 45K tokens, compared with 73.8% at 71.3K for a frozen gpt-oss-120b router and 92.4% for a retrospective fixed-order oracle. Across 10 paired model-condition settings, the oracle adds 23.2-58.3 points of retrospective coverage over Baseline, but protocol profiles vary by task. In the six settings with held-out router evaluations, oracle gaps remain 18.5-28.9 points. Confidence can therefore support initial escalation, while protocol-specific cost-aware routing remains unresolved.

</details>


### [456] [Small Models Scout Bottleneck Order for Large-Model Data Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14936)
*Seungmin Choi,Jiwon Sung,Muhammad Umer,Abhiram Rao Gorle,Guijin Son,Youngjae Yu,John M. Cioffi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"首次通过技能训练"目标与 LogFloor 控制器，发现小模型（如 70M）能侦察出大模型（如 12B）应依次突破技能瓶颈的"相位有序瓶颈轨迹"，该轨迹可通过短目标探针重放跨规模迁移，最高节省 60.3% 的训练轮次。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据混合方法（如 DoReMi、RegMix、Skill-It）多聚焦于"用哪些数据"而非"按何顺序训练"。在受监控的技能阈值（floor）场景下，训练何时停止由最弱瓶颈技能决定，均匀训练会对已达标技能造成浪费。文章提出关键问题：小模型的训练轨迹中是否蕴含另一种可迁移结构——大模型应按什么顺序解决技能瓶颈？

Method: 1) 形式化"首次通过技能训练"：每个受监控技能 k 有目标阈值 τ_k，目标为最小化所有技能首次全部达标所消耗的 token；2) 设计 LogFloor 闭环控制器：按式(5)的 softmax 计算各技能 floor 压力赤字的软分配，再以式(6)做指数平滑与边界约束，逐轮将最大份额分配给当前瓶颈；3) 跨规模迁移采用"目标探针重放"：先用 H=3 轮均匀探针在源轨迹上定位目标所处相位，再单调沿源路径分配；4) 消融诊断：静态坍缩、反序、随机置换、仅保留瓶颈标签四种对照实验，验证顺序信息的独特贡献。

Result: 在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 的五个 bAbI 技能切片、六个目标阈值（2.8–3.3）共 30 次运行中，LogFloor 全部达标，pooled 节省 56.2%，pooled 命中率 95% CI 为 [88.4%, 100%]，且 28/30 次在 heldout 上仍确认达标。70M→12B 跨规模重放（八组种子）达成 8/8 目标，pair mean 节省 30.9%，pooled 39.4%，计入源侦察成本后仍节省 37.6%；与 12B 在线 LogFloor（pair mean 34.4%、pooled 39.4%）几乎持平。MMLU-control 上冻结的 70M scout seed 2 在 8/8 个 12B 目标上 pooled 节省 60.3% 轮次；静态坍缩仅剩 10.3%、反序 6.0%、随机置换 6/8 命中、仅瓶颈标签保留 25.0%。瓶颈分配质量与节省正相关（ρ=0.589），而已达标技能分配质量负相关（ρ=-0.704）。

Conclusion: 相位有序的瓶颈解决路径是一种可迁移的课程结构，无法被静态混合比例所替代。小模型不仅能估算有用数据混合，还能在受监控的首次通过训练中侦察出大模型应按何顺序逐个击破技能瓶颈，为大规模预训练中的数据控制提供了一种新的、可解释的代理信号。

Abstract: Small proxy models are commonly used to identify data mixtures for larger-scale training. We ask whether their training trajectories reveal another transferable structure: the order in which larger models should resolve skill bottlenecks. We formulate first-passage skill training, where each monitored skill has a target floor and the objective is to minimize the tokens required to reach all floors. We introduce LogFloor, a closed-loop controller that directs each round toward current bottlenecks, producing phase-ordered resolution trajectories. Across five bAbI skill slices on Qwen2.5-1.5B, LogFloor reduces token cost by 56.2% on average. In 70M-to-12B transfer, three-round replay of a 70M scout path reaches every floor in all eight target runs, saving 30.9% by pair mean, 39.4% in pooled training tokens, and 37.6% under source-cost accounting. On MMLU-control, a frozen scout path succeeds across all eight 12B runs. Collapsing a path to its static marginal mixture or reversing its phase order removes most benefits, while bottleneck labels alone remain partially useful. These results identify phase-ordered bottleneck resolution as a transferable curriculum structure for monitored skill-targeted training.

</details>


### [457] [When Is an Agent Evaluation Over? Outcome Finality and Cross-Unit Separation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14940)
*Avyay M. Casheekar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文指出当前智能体评估中,仅凭运行终止时刻(end point)赋予最终标签存在两个独立但常被忽视的条件缺失:结果终局性(outcome finality,即后续事件是否可能改变已记录的结果)和跨单元分离性(cross-unit separation,即一次运行是否会改变另一次运行的相关条件或结果)。论文通过受控回放实验证明延迟操作和共享服务状态会使端点标签与终态标签分离,并审查了10个公开协议发现文档在这些方面普遍存在缺口,最终提出"开放效应记录"(open-effects record)规范以使相关推理可审查。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体评估方法普遍将停止时刻的可观察状态直接计为一次试验的最终分数,但停止时刻本身无法证明:(1) 已发起的异步/延迟操作后续不会改变被记录的结果;(2) 此次试验未受到先前试验遗留状态或共享服务状态的影响。近期事件(英国 AISI、OpenAI、Hugging Face)表明评估边界效应(carryover)确实在发生,但该问题在通用评估方法论中尚未被系统讨论。

Method: 1. **理论框架**: 提出"完成论证"(completion argument),将评估边界问题分解为两个独立决策——结果终局性与跨单元分离性,并各自给出所需证据与缺失证据时的处置规则(等待、取消验证、保留为未决、加边界、隔离、分组或建模连接)。2. **受控回放实验**: 基于 AgentDojo 0.1.35 构建独立回放器,固定工具调用轨迹,通过本地 HTTP 服务注入 0/25/100/250ms 延迟写入,对比快照打分、对账打分、已验证取消三种终局性策略,以及共享状态、命名空间隔离、已验证重置、无写入控制、运行顺序反转、分组分析六种分离性条件;每组合 5 个标识符 × 10 次重复。3. **文档审查**: 对 WebArena、WorkArena、OSWorld、SWE-bench、tau-bench、ToolSandbox、TheAgentCompany、RE-Bench、Cybench、AgentCanary 十个公开协议,按"未完成操作""重置或保留""独立评分证据"三个字段进行显式/部分/未报告/不适用四级编码。4. **提议"开放效应记录"**: 给出包含运行标识、触发事件、资源与控制器、观测句柄、效应状态、可能跃迁、跨运行范围、验证与分析处置等字段的规范。

Result: **终局性**: 非零延迟下快照打分与终态标签在全部 150 次试验中不一致(0/150 成功 vs 对账打分的 150/150 成功);已验证取消将 150 个待定写入全部记为失败;零延迟与同步控制下端点与终态标签一致。**分离性**: 共享状态下 A 改变 B 的得分在 200 对中发生 150 次(覆盖全部非零延迟);命名空间隔离、已验证重置、无写入控制下暴露均为 0/200;先运行 B 再运行 A 时暴露降为 0/200;分组保持 150 次暴露,行数从 400 减为 200 对。**文档审查**: 重置或保留: 显式 8、部分 2;未完成操作: 显式 0、部分 2、未报告 6、不适用 2;独立评分证据: 显式 3、部分 7。

Conclusion: 停止时刻只能决定何时打分,不能决定分数的含义。一个最终的成功/失败标签需要证明后续效应不再改变该结果,否则应报告为未决;一次独立试验需要证明遗留效应被阻断,否则应建模连接或将受影响的若干次运行视为一个更大的分析单元。十个公开协议在文档未完成操作处理与独立评分依据上普遍存在缺口。受控回放使用良性本地服务与固定轨迹,不估计在已发布基准中的发生频率或效应大小;文档审查为单编码者且不涉及私有实现。论文明确区分完成性与安全性: 等待有害操作完成可暴露危害,取消操作可提高安全性但改变原本会观察到的结果,因此论文规则不替代事件响应或安全控制。

Abstract: Current agent evaluations score models on the state visible at the end of a stopped run which they count as one trial. However, interpreting the score as a final result would require two conditions that the endpoint does not itself necessarily establish: outcome finality and cross-unit separation. These conditions are independent, since reconciling a delayed outcome can settle the label while runs still share state and isolating runs can prevent carryover while the scored outcome remains unfinished. We develop a completion argument that specifies the evidence needed for each decision and argue that a final label is justified only when anything that could still change the claimed outcome is resolved, bounded, or retained as uncertainty. First, in a controlled replay to demonstrate the mechanism where an agent's actions were held fixed, we find that the endpoint and terminal labels differ for every delayed operation, while a delayed write changes the next run's score when service state persists between runs but not after isolation or verified reset. Second, in a review of ten public protocols, we find that all protocols identify when a run stops and what is scored, while unfinished operations and the evidence for treating runs as separate trials are documented less consistently. Finally, we propose an open-effects record that lists operations or resources that may remain relevant after the endpoint, their current status, and whether they could change the scored outcome or affect another run.

</details>


### [458] [Skill Blocks: How Should an Agent Load Its Skill? A Caching-Correct Comparison of Pre-load, On-Demand Tool-Loading, Progressive Disclosure, and Hybrid](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14943)
*Hironobu Nakasuji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了四种内容保持的智能体技能加载方法（Full 全量预加载、Skill Block 核心+按需工具调用、Reference 渐进式披露、Hybrid 摘要+按需加载），在五个基准上得出"无通用最优解"的结论：选择取决于技能规模与轮次结构，正确缓存计量对多轮场景至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体技能（Agent Skills）通常作为整体在每次请求时全部注入上下文，即便该次请求仅需其中一小部分。这种"广度-成本耦合"导致覆盖范围越大、每次调用越贵，且长提示还会影响模型的信息利用效率。已有工作多聚焦于内容优化（如 SkillOpt、DSPy、TextGrad）或参数级稀疏激活（MoE），但对"在内容固定的前提下，应该如何分块、按何种顺序注入上下文"这一正交问题缺乏系统研究。此外，多轮场景下提供者将缓存读取令牌计入 input_tokens，若不加修正会严重误判成本。

Method: 构建内容保持的块化基底（YAML front matter + EJS 分块标签，含默认标记、依赖、优先级、标签），保证完整渲染可无损恢复原始技能。四种机制：(1) Full——渲染所有块；(2) Skill Block——仅留核心块+函数 schema，模型通过 load_skill_block 工具按需拉取；(3) Reference——核心+文本目录，模型先选择再读取参考文件；(4) Hybrid——核心+所有块的紧凑摘要，仅当摘要不足时调用工具取完整块。在 SearchQA（n=1400，单轮，≈2K token）、SpreadsheetBench（n=276，单轮，≈8K token）、ALFWorld（n=42，多轮，≈1K token 短流程）、ScienceWorld（n=84，多轮，≈6K token / 16 个流程）、SynthProc（n=40，多轮，≈10K token / 45 个操作）五个基准上配对评估。单轮以原始输入为主指标，多轮提出"有效输入" = 新输入 + 0.1×缓存读取以修正缓存计量；输出敏感性用 total_λ = 输入 + λ·输出_tokens（λ=1,4,8）扫描。统计采用配对 95% 自助置信区间与精确 McNemar 检验（Holm 校正）；补充使用配置为 gpt-5.6 的同供应商迁移检验。

Result: 五个基准上无单一机制通用占优：(1) 单轮小技能 SearchQA：Hybrid 减输入 27.4%（仅 1.4% 触发加载），强提示的 Skill Block 反而增 48.4%；(2) 单轮大技能 SpreadsheetBench：Hybrid/Skill Block/Reference 分别减输入 39.8%/35.6%/31.7%，静态裁剪 original8 减 55.5% 但非内容对等；(3) 多轮小且总是需要的 ALFWorld：Skill Block 仅减 12.6%，加入输出后在 λ=8 下几近持平；(4) 多轮大且可压缩的 ScienceWorld：Skill Block 减有效输入 62.5%、Hybrid 减 52.8%；(5) 多轮 SynthProc：Skill Block 减 73.0%、Hybrid 减 66.6%。九组主要配对 McNemar 检验 Holm 校正后全部 p=1.0，未检测到质量差异；缓存读取占多轮原始输入的 74–94%，如 SynthProc 参考臂原始输入高于 Full，但有效输入低于 Full 14.8%，证明缓存计量可逆转排名。配置为 gpt-5.6 的 ScienceWorld 迁移检验（n=90）维持大技能格局（减 63–69%），但内部 Skill Block 与 Hybrid 排序几乎打平。

Conclusion: 对固定技能而言，条件加载可将覆盖范围与逐次上下文成本解耦，但正确封装取决于场景。单轮若必须保留全部可选内容，Hybrid 是最佳内容对等选择；大且可压缩的多轮技能应评估 Skill Block / Hybrid 对；小且每轮都需的多轮流程在总成本敏感性下几近持平；静态裁剪虽更便宜但不构成内容对等。多轮结论必须基于缓存修正后的计量（如本工作提出的 effective_input）。本贡献是一个有边界的场景地图与计量方法，而非通用胜者；决策应基于本地的需求、空转开销与提供者计量。

Abstract: Agent skills are often injected in full on every request, increasing token cost. We compare four content-preserving loading methods: Full, Skill Block, Reference, and Hybrid. Across SearchQA, SpreadsheetBench, ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and SynthProc, we measure token usage using raw input for single-turn tasks and cache-correct effective input for multi-turn tasks. Results show no universal winner. Hybrid reduces input by 27.4% on SearchQA and 39.8% on SpreadsheetBench. On large multi-turn skills, Skill Block and Hybrid achieve substantial reductions, reaching 62.5% and 52.8% on ScienceWorld and 73.0% and 66.6% on SynthProc. ALFWorld shows smaller gains because procedures are short and repeatedly needed. Paired outcome tests detect no quality differences, though they do not establish equivalence. Overall, conditional loading is most beneficial when large portions of a skill are not needed on every turn.

</details>


### [459] [Trust Is Not Enough: Influence Calibration for On-Policy Self-Distillation in Agentic RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14945)
*Qizhen Lan,Xi Xiao,Xiangchen Guan,Mengchen Fan,Moule Lin,Jung Im Choi,Lijing Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ICSD（影响校准的自蒸馏方法），针对智能体强化学习中在线自蒸馏（OPSD）存在的"信任-效用失配"问题，通过教师导向的目标影响分数重新分配token级监督权重，无需额外模型前向传播，在ALFWorld、WebShop和Search-QA三个基准上使用GRPO和GiGPO算法在1.5B至7B模型上均取得稳定提升，7B模型在ALFWorld上达到96.1%成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OPSD方法主要依赖教师-学生一致性（即"教师信任度"）来分配token级蒸馏监督权重，但这种信任度并不能揭示强化某个token是否服务于当前策略优化目标。两个具有相同教师支持的token可能一个与优势估计一致、另一个被惩罚——本文将此称为"信任-效用失配"。在冻结的ALFWorld批次上，纯信任分配将其60.1%的教师支持权重分配给了目标反对的token。

Method: ICSD包含三个核心组件：（1）**教师导向目标影响分数**：对采样的策略比施加与教师-学生差距成比例的对数扰动，取一阶Taylor系数 u_t = Â_t·ρ_t·Δ_t 作为影响得分；（2）**批次自适应校准**：采用中位数定位和双侧单边均值尺度的非对称Laplace CDF，将非平稳信号映射为有界相对权重，处理重尾和跨批次尺度漂移；（3）**保守合成与质量守恒**：当 Δ_t<0 且 Â_t<0 时回退至继承的SDAR信任权重；在每个动作回合内通过缩放因子 α_q 严格保持原始辅助损失总量不变。计算无需额外模型前向/反向传播，仅使用RL更新已有的优势与比率。

Result: ICSD在三个基准（ALFWorld、WebShop、Search-QA）、两种策略优化算法（GRPO、GiGPO）、五组模型配置（Qwen2.5 1.5B/3B/7B 与 Qwen3 1.7B/4B）上均优于纯信任分配。Qwen2.5-7B配合GiGPO达到ALFWorld 96.1%成功率、WebShop得分93.1%/准确率84.4%。机制分析显示：受信任-冲突占比（TCM）从60.1%降至37.8%，与RL梯度的余弦兼容性提升0.192；分配消融验证了"教师信任+带符号目标影响+连续校准幅度"三要素缺一不可。运行时开销仅约端到端0.4%。

Conclusion: ICSD通过目标影响校准解决了OPSD中的信任-效用失配问题，在保持RL目标与辅助预算不变的前提下，将教师监督重新分配到目标支持的token上。理论证明其校准映射具备仿射不变性与逐回合质量守恒，实验证明该方法具有跨算法、跨模型族的稳定增益，且冻结批次分析证实了预测的质量重分配效应——将支持token的系数提升2.90×（ALFWorld）/2.64×（WebShop），将反对token降至0.79×。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) gives language agents dense token-level supervision from a privileged self-teacher on the policy's own trajectories. Existing methods allocate this supervision mainly by teacher trust, but trust does not reveal whether emphasizing a token supports the current policy objective. We call this the trust-utility mismatch and introduce Influence Calibration for Self-Distillation (ICSD). For each supervised token, ICSD measures the first-order response of its importance-weighted RL surrogate contribution to a teacher-directed output perturbation. Batch-adaptive calibration converts this non-stationary signal into a bounded allocation weight while preserving the original auxiliary-loss mass within each action turn. These detached weights affect only the distillation loss and require no additional model pass. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA, ICSD improves all matched aggregate metrics over trust-only allocation under Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and Group-in-Group Policy Optimization (GiGPO), across two model families spanning 1.5B to 7B. At 7B, it reaches 96.1% ALFWorld success and a WebShop score of 93.1. Frozen-batch analyses show that ICSD reduces teacher-supported mass assigned to objective-opposed tokens from 60.1% to 37.8% and raises cosine compatibility with the RL gradient by 0.192. A companion repository is avail- able at this https URL .

</details>


### [460] [RETRACE: Resilience-Guided Trait-Conditioned Craving Estimation from Wearable Physiology in Opioid Use Disorder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14947)
*Yi Xiao,Harshit Sharma,Dessa Bergen-Cico,Asif Salekin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RETRACE提出了一种面向阿片类药物使用障碍(OUD)患者的可穿戴生理信号渴求检测框架，将渴求检测重新定义为受心理韧性特质调节的生理信号解释问题，通过双编码器设计(冻结的应激预训练编码器+韧性条件化渴求编码器)实现无需目标用户渴求标签或逐用户重训练的轻量化个性化，在LOSO评估中比最强基线提升达7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿片类药物渴求检测面临根本性挑战：(1)渴求相关生理信号微弱、稀疏且嵌入在应激相关自主神经活动中，难以与应激区分；(2)个体间存在巨大差异，相同的生理模式在不同个体可能具有不同含义；(3)传统状态级推断范式假设生理-渴求映射在个体间稳定，这一假设在跨主体评估下变得脆弱；(4)心理韧性作为调节应激和渴求的关键特质因素，无法从短期可穿戴窗口直接可靠观测。

Method: RETRACE采用韧性引导的特质条件化框架，核心创新包括：(1)双编码器架构——冻结的应激预训练编码器提供稳定的自主神经结构参考，可训练的韧性条件化渴求编码器学习个体特异性渴求表征；(2)特征级门控——通过sigmoid门控向量对输入生理特征进行个体特异性调制；(3)表征级融合——动态融合权重α在应激表征和渴求表征之间插值；(4)训练目标包含渴求分类损失、门控稀疏性L1正则、编码器间正交化约束和辅助应力损失；(5)两种韧性代理——HR-AUC(生理恢复动力学)和自传体记忆语义嵌入。

Result: 在78个会话(含24名OUD患者28次会话)的自收集多模态OUD数据集上：LOSO协议下，HR动力学引导版本准确率达0.721，Macro-F1达0.720，比最强基线(Cross-Attn+HR动力学0.650)提升超7%；语义引导版本准确率0.704；消融实验证实自适应融合门控和冻结应激编码器是关键组件；14天野外可行性研究中语义引导平衡准确率达0.686；在Pixel 6上推理延迟14.7-16.7ms，适合边缘部署。

Conclusion: 可穿戴渴求检测需要超越短窗口状态分类，转向主体感知的生理信号解释；RETRACE通过韧性相关上下文条件化生理推断，实现了无需逐用户标签或重训练的主体感知渴求估计，验证了将个人背景作为模糊生理证据解释机制(而非仅仅是附加输入)的价值，为OUD恢复支持的可扩展可穿戴感知系统提供了实用方案，但仍需在更大规模、更多样化的纵向真实世界OUD队列中进一步验证。

Abstract: Detecting opioid craving from wearable physiological signals is critical yet difficult, with the potential to support proactive interventions for individuals with opioid use disorder (OUD). This challenge is especially pronounced under subject-independent evaluation because craving is subjective, heterogeneous, and often physiologically entangled with stress. Our empirical analysis shows that stress elicits strong and reproducible autonomic responses, while craving-related signals are weaker, sparse, and largely embedded within stress-related physiology. We further show that psychological resilience, which shapes stress regulation and craving vulnerability, is not reliably observable from short-term wearable windows, but can be captured through reusable subject-level proxies, including post-stress heart-rate recovery and autobiographical memory this http URL by these findings, we introduce RETRACE, a resilience-guided trait-conditioned framework for subject-independent craving estimation from wearable physiology. RETRACE reframes craving detection as trait-conditioned physiological interpretation: rather than assuming the same physiological pattern has the same meaning across individuals, it uses resilience-related subject context to guide inference. Technically, RETRACE introduces a novel dual-encoder design that separates generalizable stress physiology from subject-specific craving interpretation. It combines a frozen stress-pretrained encoder with a resilience-conditioned craving encoder, using feature-level gating and representation-level fusion to enable lightweight personalization without target-user craving labels or per-user retraining. We evaluate RETRACE on a novel multimodal OUD dataset containing wearable physiology, stress and craving annotations, and autobiographical narratives. Under LOSO setup, RETRACE achieves up to 7% absolute improvement over the strongest baseline

</details>


### [461] [T-LLM Compiler: Trusted LLM-based Code Optimization and Verification Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14953)
*Zahra Fazel,Sunanda Gamage,Shayan Shirahmad Gale Bagi,Amir H. Ashouri,Tomasz S. Czajkowski,Bryan Chan,Reza Azimi,Yaoqing Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: T-LLM Compiler 是一个将 LLM 代码转换、传统编译器（BiSheng）和形式化验证工具（CBMC、LLM 语义验证器）相结合的迭代式 C 代码优化框架。该框架在 PolyBench/C 基准测试上实现了高达 83.3% 的优化准确率和 16.1% 的整体加速比，正确转换的代码平均加速达 26.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 在代码优化任务上面临两大瓶颈：代码复杂度高且无法独立验证转换的正确性，导致现有方法的转换成功率较低（约 50% 甚至更低）。现有方法要么将 LLM 作为编译器替代品，要么在 LLVM-IR 层进行操作，忽视了 LLM 与传统编译器之间的互补潜力，缺少系统化的可信验证机制来保证优化的正确性。

Method: 1. **三组件协作架构**：LLM 优化器（Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct）+ 传统编译器（BiSheng Enterprise）+ 验证工具链，采用迭代式反馈循环（最多 3 次重试）。
2. **优化器（Optimizer）**：使用零样本、单样本（含五种循环优化示例：循环展开、循环合并、循环分块、循环分布、循环交换）和多样本提示策略；引入基于 LoRA 微调的 Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct 推荐器（使用 LORE 数据集训练，含 3,418 个样本），自动为输入代码选择最佳提示策略和示例。
3. **三层验证链**：① 语法验证器（编译器 -fsyntax-only 标志）；② 符号验证（CBMC 有界模型检查，使用 cvc5 SMT 求解器，循环展开深度 20）；③ LLM 语义验证器（根据 CBMC 决策——接受/拒绝/无决策——采用不同提示策略）。
4. **AI 辅助级别分类（0-4 级）**：本文工作定位为 Level 3——LLM 与传统编译器协同工作而不取代编译器。

Result: 1. **整体性能**：在 30 个 PolyBench/C 基准上，accuracy 高达 83.3%，加速比最高 16.1%；正确转换的内核平均加速 26.7%。使用"所有提示最佳选择"策略时达到 90% 转换成功率和 100% 准确率，最高平均加速 1.178×。
2. **LLM 模型对比**：Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 显著优于 CodeLlama-7B/13B（后者转换成功率仅 6.67%-10%）。
3. **验证链消融研究**：无验证时 accuracy 60%，加入完整验证链后提升至 87%（Syntax 73% → +CBMC 83% → +CBMC+3 路 LLM 87%），且验证未明显降低加速比。
4. **CBMC 验证器**：87% 准确率，8.4% 假拒绝率，33.8% 假接受率（受限于有界检查）。
5. **案例分析（doitgen）**：通过两次迭代（首次 CBMC 拒绝，第二次成功）获得 4.33× 加速，展示了 LLM 与编译器协同效应（LLM 转换后，BiSheng 自动应用 2 倍向量化）。
6. **Alive2 失效**：在 PolyBench 复杂循环结构上频繁超时，不适合 C 级转换验证。

Conclusion: T-LLM Compiler 验证了编译器、符号验证器和 LLM 三类工具协同可以显著提升代码优化的质量和可信度，83% 的成功率远超先前约 50% 的水平。其成功的关键在于：① 保留了传统编译器在底层优化中的核心地位，由 LLM 在高层进行代码转换以解锁传统编译器无法发现的优化机会；② 采用迭代式验证-重试闭环处理语法、符号和语义错误。未来工作方向包括：改进提示推荐器、探索顺序单样本提示策略、以及将方法扩展到更大规模代码库和程序级转换（目标 Level 4）。项目已开源：github.com/BiSheng-Compiler-Agents/CCE-WOZ/tree/tllm-compiler。
